jobs.title: Program Manager Talent Performance & Experience
jobs.description:
**What we will offer you:**  

**Culture:**  Join a supportive and inclusive work environment where collaboration, respect, and open communication are at the core of everything we do.
  
  

**Competitive Compensation:**  We offer a highly competitive compensation and total rewards package, ensuring that your hard work and dedication are recognized and rewarded accordingly.
  
  

**Flexibility:**  We understand the importance of work\-life balance and offer various flexible schedules to help you manage your personal and professional commitments effectively.
  
  

**Technology:**  Work with state\-of\-the\-art tools and technologies that empower you to excel in your role and stay at the forefront of industry trends.
  
  

**Employee Assistance Programs:**  We care about you! You and your family will have access to LYRA, an industry leading platform that provides comprehensive support and a myriad of resources to help support your physical, mental, financial, and social well\-being.
  
  

**Opportunity:**  A continuous focus on professional development with many opportunities for training and career growth.
  
  

**Safety Focused:**  We care about you and have developed a 24/7 safety mindset that is showcased throughout every facet of the organization.
  
  

We’re looking for a Program Manager of Talent Performance \& Experience to enable and support a workplace where every employee feels connected, empowered, and inspired to perform at their best. In this role, you’ll be the owner of programs that make work meaningful—managing projects that align individual goals with organizational priorities while fostering a culture of inclusion, growth, and recognition. You’ll build and own programs to monitor, support, and embed our Superior culture throughout a newly integrated North American organization. Areas of responsibility will include employee experience initiatives such as employee listening and recognition.
  
  

**What you’ll do:**  

* Program Management: Design, implement, and manage programs and processes to improve the employee experience, including project management, vendor management, content creation, communications, and program analytics.
* Stakeholder Engagement: Partner with relevant stakeholders to ensure the simplicity, relevancy, and value of programs, and provide guidance to HRBPs to support successful adoption.
* Recognition: Manage our internal recognition platform and lead recognition initiatives, including the creation of formal award programs tied to our new values. Evolve recognition to act as a change enabler in reinforcing new ways of working.
* Culture: Execute on our employee experience strategy with programs and initiatives to connect our employees to our culture at key moments throughout the employee lifecycle. Support our HR, safety, marketing, and communication partners in embedding our values into our organization.
* Employee Listening: Support the senior manager in executing our employee listening strategy. Manage our approach to how we listen to, learn from, and act on employee feedback.
* Technology Enablement: Leverage technology and AI to optimize performance and engagement programs.
* Compliance: Ensure adherence to employment laws and organizational policies.


**What you bring:**  

* Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent in Human Resources, Industrial Organizational Psychology, or related field required. Master’s preferred.
* 3\-5 years of relevant experience in talent management, organizational development, or related HR functions.
* Working knowledge of different philosophies around talent management and employee experience, and a practical approach to implementing best practices.
* Experience in multi\-site and multi\-national organizations preferred.
* Legal Authorization to work in the US is required. We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas now or in the future for this job opening.


**Work Location:** Fully remote candidates will be considered for the right fit.
  
  

**Pay Transparency:**  

The expected annual salary range for this role is $80,000\-$100,000 a year. This position is also eligible for an annual incentive program. Please note the compensation information shown above is a general guideline only. Salaries are based upon candidate skills, experience, and qualifications, geographical location, as well as market and business considerations
  
  

Here at Superior Plus Propane, we are an equal opportunity employer committed to the inclusion and accommodation of all individuals, we welcome all qualified candidates to apply. If you have an accommodation need during the recruitment \& selection process, we encourage you to connect with us at sppcareers@superiorpluspropane.com to let us know how we can enhance your experience.

jobs.title: Senior Recruiting Program Manager
jobs.description:
Included Health is looking for a Senior Recruiting Program Manager to lead a portfolio of recruiting programs and operational improvements. This role will focus on several key areas including internal mobility, talent brand, and process improvement. They will also manage the contingent workforce programs. Furthermore, the role will support change management for major recruiting initiatives, including the ATS transition.



This is a strategic program\-owner role for someone who can bring structure to ambiguous problems, connect business goals to execution, and drive measurable outcomes across multiple teams. The successful candidate will be a trusted advisor to Talent Acquisition management and other partners. They will influence others without direct authority, help shift programs from planning to adoption, and will ensure continuous improvement.



### **Responsibilities**


### **Recruiting Program Portfolio**


* Own recruiting programs from planning through execution, measurement, and iteration.
* Build clear program plans, milestones, stakeholder maps, risks, decisions, communications, and success measures.
* Lead the operational development of an internal mobility program.
* Support talent\-brand programs that strengthen Included Health’s employer brand proposition, diversify sources of hire, and improve the candidate experience.
* Use data and stakeholder feedback to assess progress, identify risks, and recommend action.

### **Process Improvement**


* Identify friction across the recruiting lifecycle and design simpler, more consistent ways of working.
* Improve processes through standardization, documentation, automation opportunities, and clear ownership.
* Incorporate AI and technology into recruiting processes to automate manual work, improve efficiency, and scale operations.
* Use data and feedback to evaluate whether process changes are improving efficiency, quality, and experience.
* Build repeatable playbooks and operating practices that can scale across Talent Acquisition.

### **Change Management and Adoption**


* Lead change\-management efforts for major recruiting initiatives, including the ATS transition.
* Create strategies to get stakeholders involved. Prepare communications, training materials, enablement materials, and plans for adoption.
* Partner with the technical systems owner to ensure recruiting teams are prepared for process and system changes.
* Build feedback loops, identify resistance or readiness risks, and adjust the change approach as needed.
* Measure adoption and reinforce new ways of working after launch.

### **Employer of Record and Contingent\-Workforce Management**


* Create standard operating procedures for our contingent workforce partners, making sure they follow consistent practices.
* Create clear expectations for contingent worker onboarding, performance, reporting, issue resolution, escalation, and offboarding.
* Use data to evaluate partner performance, utilization, cost, quality, and responsiveness.
* Partner with Talent Acquisition, HR, Finance, Legal, and business leaders to improve governance and decision\-making.
* Suggest useful ways to balance internal recruiting and external options. This includes vendors, agencies, contractors, and automation.

### **Cross\-Functional Management**


* Serve as a strategic partner to Talent Acquisition leaders and a trusted advisor to recruiters, hiring managers, HR Operations, HR Systems, IT, Finance, Legal, Marketing, and vendors.
* Facilitate working sessions and decision forums that progress complex work forward.
* Influence without formal authority and create accountability across teams with different priorities.
* Communicate clearly with executive, technical, operational, and frontline audiences.
* Build alignment, surface risks early, and keep stakeholders focused on measurable outcomes.
### **Required Qualifications**


* 7\+ years of experience in recruiting operations, talent programs or a related field.
* Demonstrated experience owning complex, cross\-functional programs from strategy through execution, adoption, and measurement.
* Experience leading change\-management efforts for a major process, program, or technology transition.
* Deep knowledge of recruiting processes, stakeholder needs, and the candidate, manager, and recruiter experience.
* Demonstrated ability to operate in ambiguity, define direction, and make progress with incomplete information.
* Proficient data fluency, including the ability to interpret metrics, identify trends, evaluate tradeoffs, and make evidence\-based recommendations.
* Experience managing recruiting vendors, agencies, contingent\-workforce programs, or similar external partners.
* Strong project and program\-management skills, including planning, governance, risk management, prioritization, and executive communication.
* Ability to influence and create accountability across teams without direct authority.
* Exemplary written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong judgment, organization, follow\-through, and comfort balancing strategic priorities with operational detail.
### **Preferred Qualifications**


* Experience building or scaling internal mobility, employer\-brand, talent\-brand, early\-career, or other talent programs.
* Experience designing agency governance, vendor scorecards, contingent\-workforce operating models, or workforce planning processes.
* Experience supporting an ATS or other major recruiting\-technology change

jobs.title: Mission Critical Project Manager
jobs.description:
**Company Overview**
--------------------


Upchurch is a **rapidly growing**, full\-service building engineering company providing **mechanical, plumbing, HVAC, and electrical services** across the southeastern United States. **Founded in 1970** and headquartered in Horn Lake, MS, Upchurch has grown through both **organic expansion and strategic acquisitions**, establishing a strong reputation for quality, reliability, and service excellence. We offer end\-to\-end solutions—from design and installation to ongoing maintenance and emergency support—**helping clients maximize building performance, energy efficiency, and equipment lifespan**.

**Position Summary**
--------------------


The Critical Environments Service Project Manager is responsible for the planning, coordination, execution, financial management, and successful delivery of service projects supporting mission\-critical data center infrastructure. This position serves as the primary point of contact for customers, internal service teams, vendors, subcontractors, and stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.


The Service Project Manager owns project financial performance, customer communication, schedules, procurement activities, forecasting, change order management, and overall project execution while ensuring all work is performed safely and in accordance with customer requirements, company standards, and mission\-critical operational procedures.


The ideal candidate possesses strong project management skills, customer\-facing experience, and the ability to successfully manage projects in live operational environments where uptime, reliability, and risk mitigation are essential.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


Project Planning \& Execution

* Plan, initiate, and manage service projects from kickoff through final closeout.
* Define project scope, objectives, milestones, deliverables, resource requirements, and execution strategies.
* Develop and maintain project schedules that align with customer requirements, maintenance windows, and operational constraints.
* Lead project execution while ensuring work progresses within approved schedules, budgets, and quality expectations.
* Identify project risks, obstacles, and resource constraints and implement corrective actions to mitigate impact.
* Coordinate project startup meetings, internal planning sessions, and customer progress reviews.
* Ensure project documentation remains current and accurately reflects project status and commitments.


Mission\-Critical Service and Construction Delivery

* Coordinate service and/or construction projects within live operational or under construction data center environments where uptime and reliability are critical.
* Support customer change\-management processes, maintenance activities, equipment upgrades, retrofits, corrective maintenance, commissioning, and emergency service projects.
* Ensure all work is planned and executed in accordance with approved MOPs, SOPs, Commissioning scripts, permits, customer requirements, and site\-specific operational procedures.
* Facilitate outage planning and coordination with customers, service managers, technicians, and operational stakeholders.
* Maintain awareness of electrical and mechanical system redundancy configurations, equipment dependencies, and operational risk during project execution.
* Coordinate project activities to minimize customer impact and maintain safe operational conditions.


Customer Relationship Management

* Serve as the primary customer\-facing representative for assigned projects.
* Establish and maintain strong relationships with customer stakeholders and site operations teams.
* Lead customer progress meetings, project reviews, outage planning discussions, and execution updates.
* Provide timely communication regarding project status, risks, schedule impacts, material lead times, and change requests.
* Address customer concerns professionally and work collaboratively toward successful resolutions.
* Support long\-term customer satisfaction and account growth through proactive project management and communication.


Financial \& Commercial Management

* Own project financial performance from project award through final invoicing.
* Develop and maintain project budgets, forecasts, cost\-to\-complete projections, and profitability analyses.
* Monitor labor productivity, material expenditures, subcontractor costs, and overall project performance.
* Review project financial metrics and identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency and profitability.
* Participate in Work\-In\-Progress reviews, backlog reviews, billing reviews, and forecasting activities.
* Manage project cash flow and support timely invoicing and collections activities.
* Escalate financial risks and develop recovery plans when required.


Change Order \& Scope Management

* Identify, document, price, track, and negotiate change orders.
* Ensure customer approval is obtained prior to execution of out\-of\-scope work whenever possible.
* Monitor project scope and proactively manage scope changes to protect project profitability.
* Coordinate with operations, estimating, procurement, and accounting teams regarding project modifications.


Procurement \& Vendor Management

* Coordinate procurement activities to support successful project execution.
* Manage material purchasing, lead\-time tracking, vendor communication, and delivery schedules.
* Expedite critical materials and equipment as necessary to support customer schedules.
* Work with vendors, suppliers, and subcontractors to ensure quality, performance, and timely delivery.
* Coordinate purchase orders and ensure procurement activities remain aligned with project budgets.


Resource Coordination

* Coordinate internal resources including service technicians, field leadership, subcontractors, vendors, and support personnel.
* Work closely with Service Managers to align manpower, schedules, and project priorities.

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, High Volume Recruiting
jobs.description:
Included Health is seeking a Senior Program Manager, High Volume Recruiting, to build and run the operating system for our highest\-volume hiring areas, initially Clinical, Behavioral Health and Member Care.



This role will create consistent operating cadence across high\-volume pods, improve funnel performance, manage agency and vendor effectiveness, and expand the use of automation and AI\-enabled workflows. The PM will translate hiring goals into capacity plans, identify risks early, and drive corrective action across the recruiting machine.



This is not a traditional recruiting coordinator or status\-reporting role. The successful candidate will operate as a program owner: diagnosing problems, recommending solutions, and holding cross\-functional partners accountable for measurable outcomes.



### **Responsibilities:**


### **High\-Volume Operating Model**


* Build and maintain a standardized operating model across high\-volume recruiting pods.
* Establish operating cadences, planning processes, scorecards, and escalation paths.
* Translate hiring goals into funnel requirements, capacity plans, and execution priorities.
* Maintain a consolidated view of hiring health, risks, dependencies, and corrective actions.
* Partner with pod owners to improve pacing, stakeholder readiness, funnel quality, and delivery against goals.
* Identify opportunities to standardize and scale the high\-volume model across additional hiring areas.

### **Agency and Vendor Management**


* Own day\-to\-day operating performance for high\-volume agency and vendor partners.
* Establish clear expectations and scorecards covering submissions, quality, fill rate, time\-to\-fill, pricing, responsiveness, and corrective action.
* Create a consistent process for agency onboarding, performance reviews, escalation, and offboarding.
* Shift routine agency management and reporting away from senior leaders and toward exception\-based escalation.
* Recommend when work should be handled internally, through contractors, agencies, or automation based on demand, economics, speed, role complexity, and available capacity.


**Automation and AI\-Enabled Recruiting**
* Expand BrightHire, AI interviewer, and related workflow adoption across high\-volume recruiting.
* Partner with Talent Operations on workflow design, tooling, and automation opportunities.
* Automate reporting, funnel tracking, quality monitoring, and partner performance visibility.
* Identify friction points and run targeted process\-improvement pilots.
* Measure the impact of automation through recruiter hours saved, funnel conversion, time\-to\-fill, quality, and candidate experience.

### **Reporting and Decision Support**


* Own the consolidated weekly high\-volume hiring health report.
* Report on open requisitions, aging, progress to goal, funnel health, capacity, internal versus agency mix, and at\-risk work.
* Clearly communicate what changed, what is at risk, what action is being taken, and what decision or support is needed.
* Use data to distinguish capacity gaps from execution, process, quality, prioritization, or stakeholder issues.
* Build clear recommendations for resourcing, agency allocation, and process changes.


**Cross\-Functional Partnership**
* Partner closely with leaders on Clinical/BH capacity, performance, staffing, and resourcing decisions.
* Partner with pod owners on cohort health, stakeholder readiness, funnel decisions, and corrective action.
* Work with Talent Operations to align high\-volume workflows with broader TA systems and infrastructure.
* Serve as a central escalation point for cross\-pod operating issues.
* Influence without direct authority and create accountability across recruiters, pod owners, agencies, Talent Partners, and hiring leaders.
### **Required Qualifications:**


* 7\+ years of experience in recruiting operations, program management, high\-volume recruiting, staffing, or a related field.
* Experience owning complex, cross\-functional programs from strategy through execution.
* Experience using AI\-enabled recruiting workflows.
* Strong understanding of recruiting funnels, capacity planning, conversion metrics, and hiring economics.
* Demonstrated ability to use data to diagnose problems and drive operational decisions.
* Experience improving processes through automation, technology, or workflow redesign.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate clearly with senior leaders.
* Ability to influence and create accountability across teams without direct authority.
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-changing environment.
* Sound judgment, urgency, and comfort surfacing risk early.
### **Preferred Qualifications:**


* Experience supporting Clinical, Behavioral Health, Member Care, Urgent Care, or other high\-volume hiring environments.
* Experience with recruiting systems such as Lever, BrightHire, or similar tools.
* Experience building agency scorecards, operating dashboards, or capacity models.
* Experience partnering with senior Talent Acquisition or business leaders on workforce planning.
### **Success in This Role Looks Like:**


* High\-volume pods operate against a consistent cadence, shared metrics, and clear ownership model.
* Agency and vendor performance is visible, managed against defined expectations, and escalated appropriately.
* Hiring risks are surfaced early with clear recommendations and corrective actions.
* Recruiter and pod\-owner time shifts away from manual reporting and routine coordination toward higher\-value recruiting work.
* Automation and AI workflows produce measurable improvements in efficiency, funnel health, and candidate experience.
* TA leaders have a reliable, consolidated view of high\-volume hiring performance.
* The High Volume operating model becomes repeatable across additional hiring areas.

jobs.title: Program Manager, Domains and Off-Platform Enforcement
jobs.description:
Meta is seeking a Program Manager to lead strategy and operations for domain registration management and off\-platform enforcement programs. In this role, you will drive large\-scale efforts to detect, investigate, and remediate abuse involving domain infrastructure and off\-platform activity that threatens Meta's users, products, and brand integrity. You will partner with legal, policy, trust and safety, and engineering teams to build scalable enforcement workflows, shape program strategy, and influence how Meta responds to evolving threats across the domain ecosystem.  

  

  

### **Program Manager, Domains and Off\-Platform Enforcement Responsibilities:**

* Develop and drive the strategy and roadmap for domain registration management and off\-platform enforcement programs, aligning cross\-functional stakeholders across legal, policy, trust and safety, and engineering
* Identify systemic gaps in domain abuse detection and off\-platform threat response, and design scalable operational interventions to close them
* Manage large\-scale enforcement workflows including domain takedowns, registrar escalations, and coordinated off\-platform abuse response operations
* Define program goals and success metrics, track performance against enforcement SLAs, and communicate progress and risks transparently to leadership and key stakeholders
* Evaluate tradeoffs between enforcement speed, legal risk, and operational capacity, and hold teams accountable to aligned priorities
* Leverage AI\-integrated workflows to streamline abuse signal triage, enforcement documentation, and cross\-functional coordination at scale
* Build and maintain relationships with domain registrars, registries, and external trust and safety partners to support enforcement escalations and policy alignment
* Coach peers on optimizing enforcement processes and simplifying operational workflows to improve system\-wide efficiency
* Proactively identify emerging off\-platform threat vectors and develop risk mitigation strategies that account for broader business and legal implications
* Create and deliver clear, structured communications on program status, enforcement outcomes, and strategic recommendations for diverse audiences including executive leadership

  

  

  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 8\+ years of experience in program management, trust and safety operations, or enforcement operations within a technology, legal, or domain services environment
* 8\+ years of experience managing cross\-functional programs involving legal, policy, and technical stakeholders with demonstrated ability to drive alignment and execution independently
* Experience with domain name systems, domain abuse enforcement, registrar or registry operations, or off\-platform threat response programs
* Experience defining program strategy, setting measurable goals, and tracking enforcement outcomes against operational metrics
* Experience communicating complex enforcement or operational decisions in writing to technical and non\-technical audiences, including leadership

  

  

  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Track record of building enforcement programs from early\-stage design through scaled operational execution in a fast\-moving environment
* Experience working directly with domain registrars, registries, or ICANN\-related policy bodies on abuse mitigation or enforcement escalations
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Experience applying AI or automation tools to scale trust and safety or enforcement operations workflows
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
* Familiarity with legal frameworks governing domain disputes, intellectual property enforcement, or platform liability as they relate to off\-platform abuse
* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)

  

  

  

### **About Meta:**


Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. Job Title: Cybersecurity Assessment Data Analyst
Job Category: Information Technology
Time Type: Full time
Minimum Clearance Required to Start: TS/SCI
Employee Type: Regular
Percentage of Travel Required: Up to 10%
Type of Travel: Continental US
\* \* \*
**The Opportunity:**

CACI is seeking a Cybersecurity Assessment Data Analyst to turn assessment, scan, asset, evidence, and remediation data into trusted operational insights. The analyst will support penetration testing, red team, and attack\-surface evaluation by normalizing data, validating quality, identifying trends and risk concentrations, and producing repeatable dashboards and reporting products. This is a shared analytical capability; it does not replace the technical judgment of assessment SMEs.


This position will provide continuous technical assessment support for full‑time, proactive testing of externally and internally visible federal cyber assets. This expands federal visibility by conducting continual assessments of .gov domains, subdomains, and internet‑facing assets to uncover unknown exposures, validate vulnerabilities, and provide agencies with actionable remediation guidance. This role supports the Continuous Diagnostics and Mitigation (CDM) Program’s mission to safeguard and secure cyberspace in an environment where the threat of cyber\-attack is continuously growing and evolving and is responsible for enhancing the security, resilience, and reliability of the Nation’s cyber and communications infrastructure. The CDM Program defends the United States (U.S.) Federal Information Technology (IT) networks from cybersecurity threats by providing continuous monitoring sensors (tools), diagnosis, mitigation tools, and associated services to strengthen the security posture of Government networks.


**Responsibilities:**

* Ingest, normalize, reconcile, and quality\-check data from customer\-approved assessment tools, scanners, APIs, repositories, tickets, operator evidence, and remediation workflows.


* Develop repeatable data models, queries, scripts, metrics, dashboards, and reporting packages that show asset coverage, finding trends, attack paths, severity, remediation status, and delivery performance.


* Correlate vulnerability and exposure data with CISA KEV, CVSS, EPSS, asset criticality, exploit evidence, threat context, and customer priorities.


* Investigate duplicates, conflicting identifiers, missing fields, stale records, outliers, and reconciliation issues; document source lineage and metric definitions.


* Build clear visualizations and executive summaries while preserving drill\-down access to technical evidence and limitations.


* Partner with assessment SMEs, technical writers, project management, and customer stakeholders to answer recurring and ad\-hoc questions accurately and quickly.


* Automate recurring extracts, transformations, validation checks, and deliverables using source\-controlled code and documented procedures.


**Qualifications:**

***Required:***

* U.S. citizenship is required.


* The selected candidate must meet eligibility requirements for access to sensitive information and be able to obtain a Public Trust fitness determination (High Risk).


* Ability to work in customer\-provided remote environments, use customer\-approved tools, and comply with rules of engagement, data\-handling requirements, evidence controls, deconfliction procedures, and stop\-work criteria.


* Five or more years of data analysis, cybersecurity analytics, reporting, business intelligence, or data\-engineering experience, including work with technical security data.


* Strong SQL and Python skills and practical experience with data cleaning, joins, APIs, structured files, quality validation, reproducible analysis, and version control.


* Experience building dashboards and reports in Power BI, Tableau, Splunk, Elastic, or comparable tools.


* Working knowledge of vulnerability, asset, finding, evidence, ticket, and remediation data and of concepts such as CVE, CVSS, CISA KEV, EPSS, false positives, and attack paths.


* Ability to define metrics precisely, reconcile conflicting sources, explain limitations, and communicate results to technical and executive audiences.


***Desired:***

* Experience with exposure\-management, attack\-surface, penetration\-testing, red\-team, SIEM, data\-lake, or security\-orchestration data.


* Experience with graph analytics, entity resolution, attack\-path modeling, geospatial analysis, or large\-scale internet asset data.


* AWS/Azure data services, Databricks, Snowflake, Elasticsearch, Splunk, or API\-integration experience.


* Experience developing executive cyber\-risk narratives, operational KPIs, SLA tracking, or remediation scorecards.


* Relevant data, cloud, security, Power BI/Tableau, Splunk/Elastic, or GIAC certification.

At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high\-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.

**A focus on continuous growth.**

Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.

brightfin's sales team is growing, and the systems and processes behind it need to grow with it. The CRM \& Ops Analyst owns the day\-to\-day health of brightfin's CRM (Zoho) and the operational backbone that supports the sales team: clean data, reliable reporting, and processes that hold up as headcount increases. You'll be the person sales, sales leadership, and cross\-functional partners in marketing, finance, and customer success turn to when they need the pipeline data or process to be right the first time.

 ***CRM administration (Zoho)***

* **Develop and Fine Tune Fraud Strategies:** Design, build, and implement new, real\-time defenses to detect and prevent fraudulent applications. You will constantly test and refine our strategies to stay ahead of fraudsters.
* **Balance Risk with Customer Experience:** Make thoughtful, data\-backed decisions that strike the optimal balance between risk prevention and customer experience.
* **Monitor and Report on Performance:** Create and maintain robust dashboards to track the performance of fraud strategies. You'll be responsible for reporting on key metrics like coverage, pause rates, step\-up completion rates, defense performance, and losses.
* **Optimize and Collaborate:** Work closely with our Operations, Product, Data Science, and Engineering teams to continuously improve fraud detection capabilities and strategies.


**Minimum Qualifications:**


* 3\+ years of experience in a highly analytical role (e.g., risk, business analytics, data science).
* Experience conducting analytical work with credit cards or other consumer lending products.
* Hands\-on experience designing and executing A/B or Champion/Challenger testing within application or risk funnels.
* Proven ability to problem solve end\-to\-end: from framing the question and forming a hypothesis, to analyzing the data, to communicating and debating the answer with stakeholders.
* Familiarity with SQL, Python, or other tools for data analysis.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Economics, Finance, Engineering, Mathematics, or a similar quantitative field with a record of strong academic performance.


**Preferred Qualifications:**


* Direct experience in Fraud Strategy and Analytics.
* Expertise in SQL and Python.
* Experience helping scale a business in a fast\-paced startup environment.


**Compensation:**

Annual full\-time starting base salary range: $118,000\-$135,000



This role is eligible for additional compensation in the forms of participation in our annual incentive and equity programs.



Pay is based on factors such as work experience, education, certification(s), training, skills, and competencies related to the role. Mission Lane also offers a comprehensive benefits plan, which includes paid time off, 401(k) match, a monthly wellness stipend, health/dental/vision insurance options, disability coverage, paid parental leave, flexible spending account (for childcare and healthcare), life insurance, and a remote\-first work environment.

  

**About Mission Lane:**



Founded in December 2018, Mission Lane is a purpose\-driven fintech company based in the U.S., with headquarters in Richmond, Virginia.



It all started with a realization: nearly fifty percent of the adult population in the U.S. doesn't have access to a clear line of credit. Most traditional credit card companies either overlook or overcharge this group because they have less\-than\-perfect credit scores or no scores at all. We decided this just wouldn't do.



In partnership with our sponsor banks, we offer credit cards under the Mission Lane brand name, with better, clearer terms, and a more refined customer experience than the alternatives available to people working hard to improve their credit. To date, over four million consumers have chosen Mission Lane, earning high customer ratings on Credit Karma for its market segment and industry leading Net Promoter scores.



Mission Lane has cumulatively raised over $600 million of equity from leading investors, including Invus Opportunities, QED Investors, LL Funds, funds affiliated with Oaktree Capital Management, and other leading investors.

By fostering a culture of empathy and collaboration, we create a strong sense of belonging and support for every team member.**

We are seeking a detail\-oriented and analytically driven Business Operations Specialist to join a high\-performing team responsible for supporting sales partners in managing and maintaining client books of business. In this fully remote, staff augmentation role, you will play a critical part in ensuring the accuracy of organizational data, client alignment, and segment integrity across internal systems. A typical day involves partnering with Sales, Operations, and Business Analytics teams to process and validate data changes that support critical sales planning activities — reviewing datasets, reconciling discrepancies, troubleshooting escalations, and ensuring the accuracy of account, territory, quota, and organizational data. You will collaborate with stakeholders across global regions, support reporting and analysis requests, and contribute to process improvement initiatives that enhance efficiency and data quality. :
**GFT** is seeking a **Senior Project Manager / Principal ITS Engineer** to join our Transportation Team in our New York City or Woodbury office. This role follows a **hybrid work model**, requiring regular attendance at one of these locations.  

 Working on the roadway team at **GFT** offers the opportunity to engage in transformative projects that enhance transportation infrastructure and improve community connectivity. Whether working on highways and bridges or traffic engineering, our team excels in resilient, sustainable design and construction, delivering innovative solutions that address the complexities of modern, multimodal roadway systems and ensure safe, efficient, and reliable travel for all. Explore some of our signature roadway projects here.  

**What you’ll be challenged to do:**
 As a Senior Project Manager / Principal ITS Engineer, you’ll take the lead in shaping how communities move by delivering innovative ITS and traffic signal solutions throughout New York State and New England. This role challenges you to think strategically, solve complex transportation problems, and apply emerging technologies that enhance safety, efficiency, and connectivity across our transportation networks. You’ll collaborate with skilled professionals who share a commitment to improving mobility and advancing intelligent infrastructure for the region’s future.  

The Senior PM/Principal ITS Engineer will provide both technical leadership and strategic direction. This individual will be responsible for project delivery, marketing, business development, staff development, and strengthening GFT’s position in the New York transportation market. **In this capacity, the successful candidate will be responsible for the following:*** Secure, plan, direct, and monitor all aspects of ITS, tolling and traffic engineering projects ranging from small assignments to large\-scale, multi\-discipline efforts with technical complexity
* Lead project teams through preliminary and final design, preparation of construction documents, specifications, cost estimates, scheduling, and subcontractor coordination
* Provide client\-facing leadership as Project Manager or Task Manager, ensuring delivery aligns with client expectations, agency standards, and GFT strategic initiatives
* Develop and maintain strong client relationships, supporting business development and proposal efforts including writing, presentations, and pursuit strategy
* Reinforce and expand the group’s market position and service offerings by aligning ITS practice growth with client and agency needs
* Guide, mentor, and coordinate multi\-disciplinary staff, fostering collaboration and accountability while advancing technical excellence
* Lead engineering design services throughout the project life cycle, from concept through construction
* Direct designs in accordance with the defined scope of work
* Oversee engineering analysis related to design, implementation, and operations of ITS elements and subsystems
* Evaluate complex design challenges and develop innovative techniques or procedures to address them
* Assess the impact of construction and utility work on ITS or traffic signal infrastructure and determine appropriate mitigation measures
* Approve and guide the development of engineering drawings, specifications, cost estimates, and final bid packages
* Conduct project site visits and field work as needed to ensure technical accuracy and compliance
* Lead testing efforts and resolve technical issues during new installations or modifications of ITS field equipment
* Lead project pursuits including development of proposals, letters of interest, technical approaches, and presentations.
* Collaborating with roadway, bridge, planning, and construction teams to deliver integrated transportation solutions.


:
**What you will bring to our firm:*** Bachelor’s degree in engineering (preferably civil, electrical, or transportation)
* Professional Engineer (PE) license in New York
* 15\+ years of experience in the ITS/traffic field, including leadership or senior\-level responsibilities
* Proven ability to build and maintain strong client relationships, with experience supporting proposals, pursuits, and presentations
* Leadership, organizational, and communication skills, with a track record of mentoring staff and fostering collaboration across disciplines
* Familiarity with agency CADD standards and producing electronic submissions for transportation projects
* Design and/or project management experience working for or alongside NYSDOT, NYSTA, NYCDOT, PANYNJ or other major New York/New Jersey area transportation agencies — including ITS systems, traffic signal systems, and field equipment integration
* Knowledge of industry standards such as NTCIP, NEMA, IEEE, NEC, and of regional transportation agency ITS standards/specifications
* Ability to prepare/lead design packages (plans, specs, estimates)
* Experience with MicroStation and MS Office

 **What we prefer you bring:*** Traffic signal and/or fiber optic communication system design experience

### **Compensation:**


The salary range for this role is **$155,000 \- $210,000**; Salary is dependent upon experience and geographic location.### **Featured Benefits:**

* Hybrid (in\-person and remote) work environment.
* Comprehensive benefits package including wellness programs, parental leave, and pet insurance, in addition to medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance.
* Tax\-deferred 401(k) savings plan.
* Competitive paid\-time\-off (PTO) accrual.
* Tuition reimbursement for continued education.
* Commitment to professional development, access to internal and external training programs, and support of active participation in professional organizations.
* Incentive compensation for eligible positions.

jobs.description:
NYU Langone Health is a fully integrated health system that consistently achieves the best patient outcomes through a rigorous focus on quality that has resulted in some of the lowest mortality rates in the nation. Vizient Inc. has ranked NYU Langone the No. 1 comprehensive academic medical center in the country for three years in a row, and U.S. News \& World Report recently placed nine of its clinical specialties among the top five in the nation. NYU Langone offers a comprehensive range of medical services with one high standard of care across 6 inpatient locations, its Perlmutter Cancer Center, and over 320 outpatient locations in the New York area and Florida. With $14\.2 billion in revenue this year, the system also includes two tuition\-free medical schools, in Manhattan and on Long Island, and a vast research enterprise with over $1 billion in active awards from the National Institutes of Health.
  

  

*For more information, go to* *NYU Langone Health*, and interact with us on *LinkedIn*, *Glassdoor*, *Indeed*, *Facebook*, *X*, *YouTube* *and* *Instagram*.


**Position Summary:**  

We have an exciting opportunity to join our team as a Project Manager.
  

  

In this role, the successful candidate manages small to mid\-size hospital and off\-campus design and construction activities associated with completion of projects. The successful candidate applies a comprehensive knowledge of various disciplines to be used during design and construction, as well as the methods and techniques to be utilized for installation of equipment.


**Job Responsibilities:**


* Responsible for supervision of assigned Planning and Feasibility study projects for the Engineering Dept. Reviews documents. Involved in preparation of project budgets. Responsible for record keeping and scheduling for the duration of the projects. Coordinates job meetings with architects, engineers, and end users.
* Supervise all on\-site construction, including scheduling subcontractors, resolving day\-to\-day problems on the job site, and inspecting all work during construction to ensure compliance with plans and specifications. Inspection and evaluation of work progress, equipment and construction sites to verify safety and ensure that specifications are met. Responsible for utility coordination. Responsible for obtaining necessary building permits as mandated by the local jurisdictions.
* Oversight of all work for compliance with contract documents. Review and recommendation of contractor Payment Applications and change orders. Document control and submittal to Engineering Dept. for payment processing. Ensures safety measuresInfection Control Requirements Documents (ICRA) \& Life Safety Documents (ILSM) measures required for construction. Ensures effective implementation of Hospital and client policies and procedures.
* Responsible for supervision of assigned construction projects for the Engineering Dept. Reviews construction documents and specifications. Involved in bid openings and decision of awarding contracts. Review of construction drawings and specifications. Coordinates job meetings with contractors, architects, engineers, and end users. Orders necessary materials through Purchasing Dept via Unifier. Coordinates with department managers for utility shutdowns.
* Performs other duties as assigned

  


**Minimum Qualifications:**


* Bachelor's Degree Engineering, Construction Management, or related field.
* 1 \- 2 years Healthcare Engineering Construction background, project management and supervisory experience. Excellent communication (both oral and written), interpersonal, organizational, multitasking, supervisory skills.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office especially Word, Excel, and Project.


*Qualified candidates must be able to effectively communicate with all levels of the organization.*  

  

NYU Langone Health provides its staff with far more than just a place to work. Rather, we are an institution you can be proud of, an institution where you'll feel good about devoting your time and your talents.



At NYU Langone Health, we are committed to supporting our workforce and their loved ones with a comprehensive benefits and wellness package. Our offerings provide a robust support system for any stage of life, whether it's developing your career, starting a family, or saving for retirement. The support employees receive goes beyond a standard benefit offering, where employees have access to financial security benefits, a generous time\-off program and employee resources groups for peer support. Additionally, all employees have access to our holistic employee wellness program, which focuses on seven key areas of well\-being: physical, mental, nutritional, sleep, social, financial, and preventive care. The benefits and wellness package is designed to allow you to focus on what truly matters. Join us and experience the extensive resources and services designed to enhance your overall quality of life for you and your family.

We are building a governance, risk, and compliance function to enable our company to buildproducts that can withstand regulatory scrutiny, and ensure Meta continues to meet globalregulatory requirements and manage risk. Meta's Risk and Compliance Program (RCP) is the central engine driving risk management and compliance at the company, supporting Meta and the family of apps. Within RCP, the Security Risk Program (SRP) is the second\-line function accountable for how Meta identifies, assesses, quantifies, and reports its security risk posture — delivering global security risk assessments, Capability Maturity \& Effectiveness (CME) evaluations, AI and cloud risk assessments, and board\-level and regulatory reporting.We are seeking a Security Risk Program Manager to build one of the program's highest\-priority new capabilities: security risk assessment of AI product launches. Today, AI launches receivead\-hoc coverage through security risk assessments designed for infrastructure — not forproduct\-launch cadence, and not for cross\-domain AI risk spanning Security, Privacy, Integrity,and Legal. You will design that capability from the ground up and scale it from roughly fiveassessments per quarter today to twenty or more per quarter by H1 2027, in step with Meta's AIproduct velocity.This is a builder and an influencer role in equal measure. AI launch risk cannot beassessed by one function acting alone — it requires Central Security, product groups, Privacy,Integrity, and Legal moving through a shared process on a launch timeline. You will own thatoperating model: translating product and engineering reality into a defensible risk position, andtranslating regulatory obligation into assessment work that product teams can actually absorbwithout stalling a launch. The ideal candidate is comfortable with ambiguity, effective inhigh\-pressure and fast\-moving situations, and able to build durable relationships across a widerange of technical and non\-technical stakeholders.

jobs.description:
Are you extremely good with numbers?

Do you enjoy spreadsheets, analyzing information, solving problems, and figuring out the most efficient way to accomplish something?

**Royal Maintenance Group** is a fast\-growing national contracting and property services company operating across **27 states**, and we're looking for a highly analytical person to join our team.

**You** **do not need previous estimating or industry experience**.

We are specifically interested in candidates with backgrounds or strong interests in areas such as:

* Mathematics
* Accounting
* Finance
* Computer Science
* Engineering
* Economics
* Data Analytics
* Business Analytics

What Will You Actually Be Doing?

Your job will be to help us figure out **what projects should cost**.

Our company manages large commercial projects throughout the country. Before we can price a project for a customer, someone needs to analyze the property, determine what resources will be required, calculate costs, and make sure the project can be completed profitably.

That's where you come in.

You will analyze information such as:

* Property sizes and measurements
* Labor requirements
* Material costs
* Equipment requirements
* Vendor and subcontractor pricing
* Maps and property layouts
* Historical project data
* Project specifications
* Profit margins
* Customer requirements

You'll then use that information to build accurate estimates and pricing models.

Think of the position as a combination of **math, business analysis, problem solving, and project strategy.**

**What We're Looking For:**

We care much more about **how you think** than whether you've worked in our industry before.

**You may be a great fit if:**

* You're naturally good with numbers
* You're extremely detail\-oriented
* You enjoy solving complicated problems
* You're very comfortable using computers
* You're strong with Excel or spreadsheets
* You can look at a lot of information and make sense of it
* You notice details other people miss
* You learn new systems quickly
* You're organized
* You're comfortable making decisions
* You take ownership of your work
* You're ambitious and want to grow

**Previous estimating or construction experience is NOT required.**

We will teach you our industries and how our projects work.

We're looking for someone who can bring the **analytical ability**.

The Projects

You'll work on pricing projects for major commercial properties throughout the United States.

Depending on the season and division, projects may involve:

* Snow and ice management
* Commercial roofing
* Property maintenance
* Facility services
* Other commercial contracting services

One day you might be analyzing the cost to service a portfolio of commercial properties during a snowstorm.

Another day you might be speaking with subcontractors executing the operations.

The industries change.

**The underlying job is the same: analyze the project, understand the numbers, and determine what it should cost.**

jobs.title: QA Lead and Data Analyst support for BSA/AML technology
jobs.description:
**Location\- NY (Hybrid).**

**Role Summary**

We are seeking an experienced **QA Lead \& Data Analyst** to support **BSA/AML (Bank Secrecy Act / Anti\-Money Laundering) technology** initiatives. This role will combine quality assurance leadership, data analysis, business requirements analysis, and technology testing to ensure AML systems deliver accurate, compliant, and reliable outcomes.

The ideal candidate will have strong experience in **AML/BSA technology, transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, KYC/customer data, data validation, SQL, test strategy, and defect management**. The individual will work closely with Compliance, AML Operations, Business Analysts, Technology, Data Engineering, and other stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

* Lead QA activities for **BSA/AML technology applications and enhancements**, including test planning, test strategy, execution, defect management, and reporting.
* Analyze business and functional requirements and translate them into **test scenarios, test cases, and acceptance criteria**.
* Perform data analysis and validation using **SQL** to verify data quality, transformation, calculations, mappings, and downstream outputs.
* Validate AML\-related data flows across source systems, data warehouses, transaction monitoring platforms, case management systems, and reporting solutions.
* Support testing of **transaction monitoring, customer risk scoring, alert generation, case management, sanctions screening, and AML reporting** capabilities.
* Perform end\-to\-end testing of interfaces, data feeds, batch processes, APIs, and system integrations.
* Investigate data discrepancies, system defects, failed transactions, and unexpected AML results; perform root\-cause analysis and coordinate resolution.
* Work with Business Analysts and Compliance stakeholders to clarify requirements and ensure appropriate test coverage.
* Review test results and provide clear status reporting, risks, dependencies, and defect summaries to project leadership.
* Support **SIT, UAT, regression, integration, and production validation** activities.
* Ensure appropriate documentation of test evidence, requirements traceability, defects, and approvals.
* Analyze large datasets to identify anomalies, trends, data\-quality issues, and potential gaps in AML processes.
* Partner with Technology and Data teams to validate source\-to\-target mappings and data lineage.
* Support implementation of technology changes while maintaining appropriate **BSA/AML regulatory and compliance controls**.

Required Skills

* Strong experience in **BSA/AML, Anti\-Money Laundering, or Financial Crime technology**.
* Proven experience leading **QA/testing activities** for banking or financial\-services applications.
* Strong **SQL and data analysis** skills.
* Experience with **transaction monitoring, AML alerts, case management, KYC, customer risk, or sanctions screening**.
* Experience developing **test strategies, test plans, test cases, traceability matrices, and defect reports**.
* Strong understanding of **data validation, reconciliation, data quality, and source\-to\-target mapping**.
* Experience with **SIT, UAT, regression, integration, and end\-to\-end testing**.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Excellent communication skills and ability to work with Compliance, Operations, Business, Data, and Technology teams.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience with AML platforms such as **NICE Actimize, Oracle Financial Services, SAS AML, FIS, Verafin, or comparable solutions**.
* Experience with **ETL/data warehouse testing** and large\-volume transaction data.

jobs.title: Principal Technical Program Manager — Partner GTM Systems & Technology
jobs.description:
**Overview**
------------


Role Overview
Intuit is undergoing a major transformation to modernize, unify, and scale our global partner ecosystem. The Global Partner Program (GPP) is our unified GTM framework designed to standardize enrollment, tiering, commercial benefits, and support experiences for all partner tracks—including Accountants, Value\-Added Resellers (VARs), Developers, and ISVs—under a single platform: the Intuit Partner Suite (IPS).  

As the Technical Program Manager for Partner GTM Systems \& Technology Roadmap, you will own the technical execution engine of this program. You will serve as the single operations interface into the data and systems engineering teams. Your mission is to translate high\-level program strategies into robust technical specifications, maintain and author all Business Requirements Documents (BRDs), manage the prioritization of the system roadmap, and aggressively mitigate technical risks to ensure flawless rollouts.

 **Responsibilities**

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* **Own the Technical Backlog \& Roadmap:** Drive the technical prioritization, sequencing, and delivery roadmap for the Intuit Partner Suite (PRM/Portal) and integrated GTM tools (Salesforce, DocuSign, Quickbase, and Varicent) in direct partnership with systems and engineering leaders.
* **Business Requirements (BRD) Authorship \& Lifecycle:** Author, update, and finalize comprehensive Business Requirements Documents (BRDs). You will translate complex partner strategies, multi\-tier revenue share structures, lead registration/protection rules, and tier\-aware support routing—into clear, implementation\-ready logic for developers.
* **Single Operations Interface to VEP/Engineering:** Act as the centralized point of contact for all technical requirements, unifying and streamlining communication channels to eliminate historical fragmentation between business, ops, and engineering.
* **Cross\-Functional Requirements Gathering:** Collaborate deeply with GPP Program Strategy to capture strategic intent, and PMO to map system dependencies, ensuring technical plans directly support GPP launch\-readiness schedules.
* **Technical Risk \& Blocker Mitigation:** Identify, track, and resolve system constraints and delivery risks. Focus areas include resolving data residency/GDPR requirements for international markets (UK, Canada, Australia) and managing the technical transition of legacy partner data into the new platform.
* **System Validation \& UAT Governance:** Define the operational quality standards and “Definition of Done” for technical deliverables. Lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and system validation to ensure shipped platform features exactly match defined business policies before they go live to partners.

 **Qualifications**

**Required Qualifications \& Experience**
-----------------------------------------

* **Systems Implementation Expertise:** 6\+ years of experience leading complex, large\-scale systems implementations across CRM (Salesforce/SFDC), Partner Relationship Management (PRM) platforms, Billing/Commerce engines, or Enterprise Data Warehouses.
* **Exceptional Business Analysis (BRD Writing):** A proven track record of writing exceptionally detailed, logic\-driven Business Requirements Documents (BRDs) that govern complex automation (e.g., tiered point accruals, referral payouts, and API\-driven data integrations).
* **Technical Translator:** Exceptional capability to bridge the gap between abstract business strategy and core engineering requirements, comfortably negotiating scope and trade\-offs with both Executive Directors and System Architects.
* **Cross\-Functional Collaborator:** Experience navigating highly matrixed enterprise organizations, with a demonstrated ability to align diverse stakeholder groups (Sales, Ops, Product, Success, Finance, and Legal).
* **Detail\-Oriented \& Risk\-Aware:** High analytical rigor with experience using structured risk\-management frameworks to identify operational constraints, system bugs, and process inefficiencies before they impact launch milestones.
* **Agile/Scrum Experience:** Strong familiarity with Agile delivery methodologies, backlog grooming, and Jira\-based sprint management.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience with PRM tools (e.g., Salesforce PRM, Impartner, ZiftONE).
* Familiarity with financial incentive systems (e.g., Varicent or automated revenue share platforms).
* Direct experience working within B2B SaaS partner programs, channel operations, or agency reseller ecosystems.

  

Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers \| Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager
jobs.description:
Job ID: 2616541

**Location:** Bethesda, MD, US

**Date Posted:** 2026\-09\-04

**Category:** Program Management

**Subcategory:** Program Mgmt

**Schedule:** Full\-Time

**Shift:** Day Job

**Travel:** Yes \- 10% of the time

**Minimum Clearance Required:** TS.SCI\_wPoly

**Clearance Level Must Be Able to Obtain:** None

**Potential for Remote Work:** ORA\_ON\_SITE

 **Description**


﻿SAIC, a leading provider of systems development \& deployment, targeting \& intelligence analysis, systems engineering \& integration, and training capabilities and solutions for the Intelligence Community, is seeking mission\-first professionals to fulfill their career goals and objectives while delivering day\-to\-day excellence on programs of national importance.



 SAIC seeks an experienced and results\-oriented, Senior Program Manager (PM) to manage our Prime contract focused on Technical Exploitation. This includes the daily management of a small team of seasoned professionals and well and the internal SAIC PM reporting and accountability requirements. The PM is the primary point of contact with the COR for matters involving technical performance, cost, and schedule and communication of progress and problems in a timely manner. The PM shall perform project managerial duties, which include but are not limited to maintaining required staffing levels of qualified personnel and assuring quality, content, and prompt delivery of all task and contractual deliverables. This position is primarily based at the customer site in Bethesda, MD.



 Responsibilities:


* Primary focal point for contract performance, to include technical performance, cost, schedule, security, staffing, and allocation of appropriate skill mix aligned with tasking and contract deliverables.
* Delivering on\-contract strategic and organic growth opportunities.
* Provide regular reports to SAIC leadership on customer requirements/changes.
* Implement and manage on\-boarding activities.
* Ensure the required level of expertise and competency of personnel are maintained in all assignments and kept current with rapidly evolving technologies.
* Ensure delivery of on\-time and quality work\-related products to the Customer and SAIC leadership.
* Ensure vacant positions are filled within the contract timelines by maintaining a pipeline of qualified candidates.
* Maintain awareness of SAIC solutions and surge support skills to present to customer at strategic opportunities.
* Coordinate and participate in quarterly Project Management Reviews (PMR)  

Track, manage, and control contract costs.

**Qualifications**


**Required Skills**

* Active TS/SCI with eligibility/ability to obtain and maintain a Counterintelligence Polygraph Clearance is required. Candidates without this cannot be considered.
* Bachelor’s Degree
* Minimum eight (8\) years of PM, project management, or technical leadership experience
* 18\+ years of overall professional experience
* Experience as a Program Manager managing teams of 10 or more technical professionals
* Experience in bringing innovative approaches to address complex problems bridging operational and technical domains
* Strong analytic ability to evaluate programmatic data, resolve inconsistencies and propose solutions to program issues
* Strong organizational skills
* Outstanding verbal and written communications skills
* Excellent interpersonal skills, including the ability and willingness to initiate and manage relationships across the customer leadership team

**Desired:**

* Bachelor’s Degree in STEM\-related field
* PMP
* 15 years of related work experience
* Experience as PM of technical exploitation teams
* Knowledge of military structure
* Prior experience managing an IDIQ contract


Target salary range: $200,001 \- $240,000\. The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position based on experience and other factors.

 **Description**


We are seeking an experienced and mission\-focused **Technical Program Manager (PM)** to lead, coordinate, and accelerate the delivery of cutting\-edge AI/ML and secure cloud concepts and solutions across several key IC programs. **This is a Hybrid role and are open to candidates in Chantilly VA or NOVA.****Candidates must have an active TS/SCI Clearance.** Your primary mission is twofold:



* **Programmatic Execution:** Serve as the primary **programmatic liaison and task manager** interfacing with the various external program teams that our matrixed team supports. Your mission is to collect incoming program requests, manage intermixed timelines, and coordinate deliverables for execution and business growth.


* **Accreditation Leadership:** Drive the Risk Management Framework (RMF) and Authority to Operate (ATO) processes to transition AI/ML prototypes into operational high\-side environments.
  


**1\. Inter\-Program Liaison \& Task Management (40%)**


* **Act as the Central Interface:** Serve as the primary point of contact for the various program leads we support. Build strong relationships with these stakeholders to understand their unique deliverables, timelines, and technical expectations.
* **Triage \& Manage the Backlog:** Gather, organize, and prioritize task requests from different programs into a single, cohesive team backlog. Coordinate schedules to prevent conflicts and ensure realistic milestones.

  


**2\. Security Compliance \& Accreditation Coordination (30%)**


* **Guide the ATO Process:** Partner with our security stakeholders to navigate the Risk Management Framework (RMF / ICD 503\) and compile the necessary documentation (such as System Security Plans) to get our software accredited.
* **Act as Compliance Liaison:** Support interfacing with Government Security Officers (ISSOs/ISSMs), translating technical features into compliance solutions as necessary.
* **Secure Developer Environments:** Work hand\-in\-hand with internal Corporate IT, facilities, and security groups to set up, upgrade, and maintain the secure workspaces, labs, and closed areas our team needs.
* **Support Tech Execution:** Assist developers in testing, refining, and documenting experimental code and models.
* **Technical Architecture Development:** Collaborate with our core AI/ML Developer to help architect, research and design rapid, high\-fidelity proof\-of\-concept demos.

  


**3\. Developer Support (30%)**


* **Support Tech Execution:** Assist developers in testing, refining, and documenting experimental code and models.
* **Technical Architecture Development:** Collaborate with our core AI/ML Developer to help architect, research and design rapid, high\-fidelity proof\-of\-concept demos.


**Qualifications**


* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline with 14 years of experience or master’s degree with 12 years of experience.
* **Candidates must be U.S. Citizens**
* **Active TS/SCI Clearance**
* **Task Coordination \& Liaison Skills:** 3\+ years of experience coordinating tasks, managing backlogs, or acting as a liaison between teams in a technical setting (e.g., IT, software, or engineering environments)
* **Familiarity with Government Accreditation Process:** Basic understanding or working familiarity with secure systems, security plans, or the accreditation process (RMF/ATO) in government environments.
* **AI/ML Architect:** Practical experience writing basic Python code and providing support to architect/whiteboard solutions for complex problems.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience deploying systems in secure, multi\-tenant cloud environments (e.g., AWS C2S / SC2S, Azure Government) or air\-gapped networks.
* Familiarity with IC missions


Target salary range: $160,001 \- $200,000\. The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position based on experience and other factors.

jobs.title: Senior Program Analyst - International
jobs.description:
Responsibilities:

Noblis is positioned to provide technology and operational solutions to senior decision makers in the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) in the Science and Technology (S\&T) Directorate. The DHS S\&T Directorate is the primary research and development arm of DHS and manages science and technology research, from development through transition, for the Department's operational components and first responders. Established by Congress to provide innovative solutions to the nation's homeland security challenges, S\&T is the core source of scientific and engineering expertise for DHS and is uniquely postured to enhance our nation's security and resilience by providing knowledge products and innovative technology solutions for the Homeland Security Enterprise (HSE).  

  

At Noblis and Noblis ESI, we have excellent teams of smart, collaborative, proactive experts and professionals. We are actively seeking to identify personnel to join our team of talented professionals who possess the experience, vision, commitment, and integrity to successfully support the S\&T mission.

  

The Senior Program Analyst – International will provide strategic, analytical, and program management support to the International Cooperative Program Office (ICPO) within the Department of Homeland Security’s (DHS) Science \& Technology Directorate (S\&T). ICPO enables DHS international engagements that discover innovation, leverage international capabilities, drive solutions, and influence science and technology security advancement world\-wide.  

The ICPO team develops partnerships with foreign governments and international organizations that enhance scientific and technical knowledge for homeland security purposes. International cooperative partnership can improve operational effectiveness, enhance affordability, and provide S\&T access to broader knowledge\-base and partner capabilities to provide impact across DHS mission areas.  

This position will support portfolio\-level engagements by providing project management, facilitation, and relationship management. The role requires engaging across S\&T, DHS, and USG partners to understand customer needs; analyzing technology requirements and partner capabilities; and developing engagement recommendations across regions. The successful candidate will navigate the nuanced relationships intrinsic to foreign partnerships.  

The successful candidate will be self\-motivated, operate well in a matrixed environment, effectively manage competing priorities, and be able to distill and communicate complex concepts to enable nontechnical managers to make informed decisions. **This is currently a hybrid position with a blend of on\-site and remote work, requiring staff to be on\-site at the DHS S\&T client site in Washington D.C. as needed. Applicants must be able to regularly commute to Washington D.C.**  

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:* Aggregating and synthesizing knowledge and data to inform decisions, analyses, and recommendations across mission areas.

jobs.title: Project Manager REMOTE
jobs.description:
**Location:** Remote (CONUS) with availability during Eastern Time core hours


**Clearance:** Active Secret Clearance required


**Job Type:** Full\-time


**Contract Type:** Government Contract (Base Year \+ 4 Option Years)


### **Position Overview**



We are seeking an experienced Project Manager to lead a high\-impact contract supporting the Assistant Secretary of the Army for Acquisition, Logistics, and Technology (ASA(ALT)). This role provides overall management and oversight of contractor personnel supporting the Project Management Resource Tool (PMRT) program, which enables program offices to manage financial and programmatic data, automate processes, and provide data visualization for senior\-level decision\-making.



The ideal candidate is a certified project management professional with a proven track record managing Department of Defense (DoD) or Department of the Army (DA) financial and acquisition programs. This position serves as the single accountable manager for task order performance and acts as the primary interface with government leadership, including the Contracting Officer's Representative (COR) and the Technical Point of Contact (TPOC).



This is a non\-personal services contract position. The Project Manager reports directly to the Prime Contractor for all human resources, disciplinary, and administrative matters, while receiving work direction and prioritization from government stakeholders.


### **Key Responsibilities**



The Project Manager serves as the single accountable manager for all task order performance, ensuring disciplined execution of approved plans, schedules, and governance processes. This position acts as the primary interface with government stakeholders, including the GSA AAS COR, ASA(ALT) TPOC, and other program authorities, and directs and coordinates cross\-functional contractor teams operating across multiple locations. Regular status briefings are provided to Government leadership on cost, schedule, performance, and risk, with a focus on timely communication, issue escalation, and resolution in support of Government decision\-making.



Contract and performance oversight includes managing and overseeing all activities performed by contractor personnel and subcontractors, ensuring compliance with all Performance Work Statement requirements and deliverables. The Project Manager develops and implements Transition\-In and Transition\-Out plans, coordinates the Project Kick\-Off Meeting and bi\-weekly Technical Status Meetings, and prepares Monthly Status Reports including risk registers and performance metrics. Additionally, this role maintains visibility into accumulated and projected costs, invoiced amounts, and labor utilization.



Quality and risk management responsibilities include administering quality management in accordance with the approved Quality Control Plan, managing risk registers, implementing corrective actions as required, ensuring all deliverables meet Section 508 compliance requirements, and overseeing personnel leave/absence planning and replacement procedures.



Key deliverables include Monthly Status Reports due by the 10th business day of each month, Project Kick\-Off Meeting coordination and minutes, Transition\-In and Transition\-Out Plans, Technical Status Meeting minutes, a Quality Control Plan, and a Personnel Leave/Absent Plan.


### **Required Qualifications**



The Project Manager must be a U.S. citizen with a current active Secret security clearance and possess a current project or program management certification such as PMP or PgMP. This position requires a minimum of five years of recent experience managing programs or supporting DoD financial systems of comparable size, scope, and complexity within the last seven years. Comprehensive knowledge of the Planning, Programming, Budgeting, and Execution (PPBE) process is essential, along with hands\-on experience with GFEBS and other defense business and accounting systems. The Project Manager must also maintain CMMC Level 1 status.



The ideal candidate demonstrates exceptional leadership abilities with a track record of leading cross\-functional teams and communicating effectively with senior government leadership. Strong judgment and the ability to make independent decisions to accomplish goals are essential.


### **Work Conditions**



Core hours are 0900 to 1600 Eastern Time, Monday through Friday. This position may be performed from anywhere CONUS, provided the candidate is readily available during core hours for on\-demand support, status reporting, and issue resolution. The Project Manager is designated as a "Key Person," and any proposed substitution requires written concurrence from the Contracting Officer with substitute qualifications equal to or greater than the original Key Person.


### **Equal Opportunity Employer**



We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.
