jobs.title: Principal Technical Program Manager — Partner GTM Systems & Technology
jobs.description:
**Overview**
------------


Role Overview
Intuit is undergoing a major transformation to modernize, unify, and scale our global partner ecosystem. The Global Partner Program (GPP) is our unified GTM framework designed to standardize enrollment, tiering, commercial benefits, and support experiences for all partner tracks—including Accountants, Value\-Added Resellers (VARs), Developers, and ISVs—under a single platform: the Intuit Partner Suite (IPS).  

As the Technical Program Manager for Partner GTM Systems \& Technology Roadmap, you will own the technical execution engine of this program. You will serve as the single operations interface into the data and systems engineering teams. Your mission is to translate high\-level program strategies into robust technical specifications, maintain and author all Business Requirements Documents (BRDs), manage the prioritization of the system roadmap, and aggressively mitigate technical risks to ensure flawless rollouts.

 **Responsibilities**

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* **Own the Technical Backlog \& Roadmap:** Drive the technical prioritization, sequencing, and delivery roadmap for the Intuit Partner Suite (PRM/Portal) and integrated GTM tools (Salesforce, DocuSign, Quickbase, and Varicent) in direct partnership with systems and engineering leaders.
* **Business Requirements (BRD) Authorship \& Lifecycle:** Author, update, and finalize comprehensive Business Requirements Documents (BRDs). You will translate complex partner strategies, multi\-tier revenue share structures, lead registration/protection rules, and tier\-aware support routing—into clear, implementation\-ready logic for developers.
* **Single Operations Interface to VEP/Engineering:** Act as the centralized point of contact for all technical requirements, unifying and streamlining communication channels to eliminate historical fragmentation between business, ops, and engineering.
* **Cross\-Functional Requirements Gathering:** Collaborate deeply with GPP Program Strategy to capture strategic intent, and PMO to map system dependencies, ensuring technical plans directly support GPP launch\-readiness schedules.
* **Technical Risk \& Blocker Mitigation:** Identify, track, and resolve system constraints and delivery risks. Focus areas include resolving data residency/GDPR requirements for international markets (UK, Canada, Australia) and managing the technical transition of legacy partner data into the new platform.
* **System Validation \& UAT Governance:** Define the operational quality standards and “Definition of Done” for technical deliverables. Lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and system validation to ensure shipped platform features exactly match defined business policies before they go live to partners.

 **Qualifications**

**Required Qualifications \& Experience**
-----------------------------------------

* **Systems Implementation Expertise:** 6\+ years of experience leading complex, large\-scale systems implementations across CRM (Salesforce/SFDC), Partner Relationship Management (PRM) platforms, Billing/Commerce engines, or Enterprise Data Warehouses.
* **Exceptional Business Analysis (BRD Writing):** A proven track record of writing exceptionally detailed, logic\-driven Business Requirements Documents (BRDs) that govern complex automation (e.g., tiered point accruals, referral payouts, and API\-driven data integrations).
* **Technical Translator:** Exceptional capability to bridge the gap between abstract business strategy and core engineering requirements, comfortably negotiating scope and trade\-offs with both Executive Directors and System Architects.
* **Cross\-Functional Collaborator:** Experience navigating highly matrixed enterprise organizations, with a demonstrated ability to align diverse stakeholder groups (Sales, Ops, Product, Success, Finance, and Legal).
* **Detail\-Oriented \& Risk\-Aware:** High analytical rigor with experience using structured risk\-management frameworks to identify operational constraints, system bugs, and process inefficiencies before they impact launch milestones.
* **Agile/Scrum Experience:** Strong familiarity with Agile delivery methodologies, backlog grooming, and Jira\-based sprint management.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience with PRM tools (e.g., Salesforce PRM, Impartner, ZiftONE).
* Familiarity with financial incentive systems (e.g., Varicent or automated revenue share platforms).
* Direct experience working within B2B SaaS partner programs, channel operations, or agency reseller ecosystems.

  

Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers \| Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.


The expected base pay range for this position is:
  

California Remote (Bay Area) $238,000\- $322,000  

California Remote (Not Bay Area) $219,500\- $297,000

jobs.description:
About NFF:

Since 1996, NFF has designed, architected, and delivered IT network and security solutions to many state, and local government agencies, K\-20 educational institutions, federal agencies, and large enterprise businesses across the mid\-Atlantic. NFF is a technology services and solutions provider, specializing in next\-generation IT infrastructure including networks, data centers, cloud migrations, IT security, collaboration and mobility, and full/part\-time staff augmentation services. Our solutions, professional services and IT staffing portfolio are centered around building more resilient, secure, adaptive, and intelligent IT infrastructure and include comprehensive assessment, architecture, design, integration and installation services, and ongoing performance management services though our Network Operations Center (NOC).  

NFF is a Cisco Gold Partner with a Customer Experience Specialization and was a “Cisco Top\-5 Mid\-Atlantic SLED Partner” in 2019, 2020 and 2022\. NFF has maintained Cisco Gold Partnership since 2008, is the only Cisco Gold Partner headquartered in the District of Columbia. In addition to Cisco, NFF has key partnerships with many manufacturers and IT solution providers including, Rapid7, Arctic Wolf, VMware, NetApp and Splunk. **NFF is a District of Columbia (DC) Certified Business Enterprise (CBE) and a SBA Certified Small Business with headquarters in downtown Washington, DC. Our dedication to quality is reflected in our accomplishment of being awarded multiple ISO 9001:2015 certifications.**
About this Position / Responsibilities:

NFF Inc. is seeking a Senior Project Manager to lead the day\-to\-day execution of a multi\-year ERP modernization program. This role will oversee the transition of Human Capital Management (HCM) and Finance from Oracle PeopleSoft to Oracle Fusion Cloud Applications while supporting the continued integration of the PeopleSoft Campus Solutions student environment for the System Office and 23 member colleges.  

The Senior Project Manager will be responsible for integrated project planning, governance, stakeholder coordination, schedule and budget oversight, risk and issue management, vendor coordination, and executive reporting. The role will help drive business and technical alignment across the modernization effort while ensuring successful delivery through planning, testing, cutover, stabilization, and transition to ongoing operations.### **Key Responsibilities**

* Lead integrated project planning, scheduling, and execution across business and technical workstreams.
* Establish project foundations, including project charters, baseline plans, governance routines, and status reporting.
* Manage scope, schedule, budget, milestones, issues, risks, assumptions, dependencies, decisions, and change requests.
* Serve as the primary point of coordination among project sponsors, business owners, colleges, technical teams, and vendors.
* Facilitate stakeholder meetings, workstream reviews, steering committee preparation, and executive communications.
* Support readiness, strategy, design, configuration, prototype review, and business sign\-off activities.
* Oversee data conversion planning, reconciliation, issue resolution, and certification activities.
* Direct testing readiness across system testing, integration testing, and user acceptance testing.
* Coordinate cutover planning, readiness assessments, contingency planning, and go\-live decision support.
* Lead hypercare and stabilization activities and support transition to sustaining operations teams.
* Coordinate technical dependencies involving Oracle Fusion, PeopleSoft, integrations, reporting, analytics, and downstream systems.
* Monitor vendor performance, milestone completion, invoice support, and budget tracking.
* Maintain documentation required for governance, compliance, funding visibility, and audit readiness.
* Drive continuous improvement and ensure project delivery aligns with approved objectives, standards, and implementation best practices.


Qualifications:
### **Required Qualifications**

* **Bachelor's degree in information systems, business, project management, or a related field; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.**
* 5\+ years of project management experience, including experience supporting enterprise applications or large\-scale IT initiatives.
* Demonstrated experience leading full lifecycle ERP, HCM, Finance, or cloud modernization projects.
* Working knowledge of Oracle PeopleSoft, Oracle Fusion Cloud Applications, or similar enterprise platforms.
* Experience managing integrated schedules, budgets, RAID logs, milestone reporting, and formal change control processes.
* Experience coordinating cross\-functional stakeholders, including business, technical, executive, and vendor teams.
* Strong written and verbal communication, facilitation, analytical, and problem\-solving skills.
* Experience supporting testing, data conversion, cutover planning, go\-live readiness, and post\-implementation stabilization.

**Preferred Qualifications*** **Experience in higher education, public sector, or multi\-entity enterprise environments.**
* Familiarity with governance, compliance, procurement, funding, and audit reporting requirements.
* Proficiency with tools such as Microsoft Project, Jira, Microsoft Teams, Excel, and related project reporting tools.
* **PMP or comparable project management certification preferred.**

jobs.description:
Overview:

Systems Planning and Analysis, Inc. (SPA) delivers high\-impact, technical solutions to complex national security issues. With over 50 years of business expertise and consistent growth, we are known for continuous innovation for our government customers, in both the US and abroad. Our exceptionally talented team is highly collaborative in spirit and practice, producing *Results that Matter*. Come work with the best! We offer opportunity, unique challenges, and clear\-sighted commitment to the mission. SPA: Objective. Responsive. Trusted.  

The Joint, Office of the Secretary of Defense, Interagency Division provides expert support services to a range of customers spanning across the Department of Defense, Federal Civilian, and international markets. JOID provides a diverse portfolio of analytical and programmatic capabilities to help our customers make informed decisions on their most challenging issues.

  

SPA provides critical decision support to enabling and executing a strategy of technological superiority and enabling the delivery and sustainment of secure, resilient, and preeminent capabilities to the warfighter quickly and cost effectively. Our team of experienced military, technical, and operations research analysts is skilled in evaluating military problems, identifying the driving factors, devising innovative approaches, collecting applicable data, developing necessary software tools, and performing thorough and timely assessments to inform technology and acquisition governance decisions to ensure U.S. military forces retain military superiority in the future.

  

We have a near\-term need for a Program Analyst to provide onsite support out of DARPA in Arlington, VA.


Responsibilities:

The candidate will provide program support to the Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency (DARPA) and will learn DARPA processes, procedures, and culture. Will coordinate periodic (monthly or bi\-weekly) internal and external meetings for the Program Manager. Monitor and track the programmatic progress of various performers and keep the Program Manager abreast of progress through daily communications, monthly reports, and other reports as needed. Provide input to and coordinate development of draft briefings, reports, and various other documents to support the development and approval of new and current program concepts and technologies.
This is a full\-time on\-site position in Arlington, VA. Up to 15% travel may be required.
Qualifications:
**Required:*** Bachelor’s degree in science, technology, engineering or math (STEM); may substitute a non\-technical degree with demonstrated technical acumen.
* Active DoW Secret clearance.
* 5\+ years of direct experience in a program analyst or related role, preferably in a research and development (R\&D) environment.
* Demonstrated experience in at least two of the following: financial budget management, acquisition document coordination, meeting organization, or developing briefings.
* Knowledge of DoW standards and regulations.
* Self\-starter with excellent oral and written communication skills, with mature judgment and attention\-to\-detail.
* Proficiency with software suites such as Microsoft 365, Word, PowerPoint, and Excel.
* Ability to report fully onsite in Arlington, VA.

**Desired:*** Experience working in or with DARPA.

Elements of the compensation package include competitive base pay and variable compensation opportunities. SPA provides eligible employees with an opportunity to enroll in a variety of benefit programs, generally including health insurance, flexible spending accounts, health savings accounts, retirement savings plans, life and disability insurance programs, and a number of programs that provide for both paid and unpaid time away from work. The specific programs and options available to any given employee may vary depending on eligibility factors such as geographic location, date of hire, etc. Please note that the salary information shown below is a general guideline only. **Position Summary:**


The Vehicle Programs and Services division is responsible for the development, implementation, and operations of the National Motor Vehicle Title Information System (NMVTIS) Consumer Access Provider (CAP) and Junk, Salvage, Insurance (JSI) programs.


The Program Manager will lead the strategic planning, roadmap development, and execution of the NMVTIS CAP and JSI programs. This role combines strategic thinking with hands\-on execution, requiring a leader who can develop comprehensive program strategies, create detailed roadmaps, manage complex budgets, and drive successful implementation across multiple stakeholder groups. The position demands expertise in program management, strategic planning, financial management, and the ability to translate vision into measurable results.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:*** Strategic Planning \& Vision Development (20%)

* Support development of comprehensive 3\-5 year strategic plans for CAP and JSI programs aligned with organizational objectives and industry trends
* Work with Program Director and the Business Development division in strategic analysis of market conditions, competitive landscape, and regulatory environment to inform program direction
* Participate in strategic planning sessions with senior leadership, stakeholders, and cross\-functional teams
* Recommend strategic opportunities for program expansion, enhancement, and optimization
* Develop comprehensive stakeholder engagement strategies for approved data providers, reporting entities, and government agencies
* Create communication strategies that align stakeholder expectations with program objectives
  

* Program Roadmap Development \& Management (25%)

* Develop detailed program roadmaps spanning 12\-24 months with clear milestones, dependencies, and deliverables
* Create integrated roadmaps that align CAP and JSI program initiatives with interdependent programs and technical systems
* Design phased implementation approaches that minimize risk while maximizing value delivery

* Lead prioritization processes to rank initiatives by strategic value, feasibility, and resource requirements
* Identify and manage cross\-program dependencies, resource conflicts, and integration points, and develop contingency planning for critical roadmap elements
* Create communication plans that keep stakeholders informed of roadmap progress and changes

* Manage program execution using established project management methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, Hybrid approaches)
* Coordinate cross\-functional teams including IT, legal, finance, communications, and external vendors
* Manage program risks and issues
* Develop and maintain program documentation including policies, procedures, and best practices
* Coordinate audits and regulatory reviews for both CAP and JSI programs, when necessary
* Implement quality control processes that prevent issues and ensure consistent program delivery
* Directly manage day\-to\-day program operations and tactical decision\-making
* Lead regular team meetings, sprint planning, and operational reviews

* Budget Management \& Financial Planning (20%)

* Develop comprehensive annual and multi\-year budgets for CAP and JSI programs based on strategic plans and roadmaps
* Create detailed budget models that account for personnel, technology, vendor contracts, and operational expenses
* Conduct cost\-benefit analysis for proposed initiatives, when needed
* Track and report program financial performance against budget with monthly reporting and variance analysis
* Recommend budget allocations and reforecasting
* Execute procurement processes and manage vendor contract negotiations
  
* Analyze user fee structures and recommend optimizations to support program sustainability
* Develop financial models for new program initiatives and service offerings
* Coordinate with approved data providers on fee structures

* Strong leadership as well as verbal and written communication skills.

Offices of Chief Counsel in developing all SLAs.

jobs.description:
Business Analyst


Business Technology Integrators (BTI) is a Service\-Disabled Veteran\-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) with more than 25 years of experience delivering innovative and reliable IT and engineering solutions to the Federal Government. BTI supports mission\-critical programs across defense and civilian agencies, with core expertise in cybersecurity, program management, enterprise IT, and technical oversight services.  

BTI is currently searching for a Business Analyst to fulfill the roles and responsibilities below: **Roles** **and** **Responsibilities**
The Business Analyst is responsible for eliciting, analyzing, documenting, and validating functional and non\-functional requirements for the EFAST2 system across the full lifecycle of the modernization effort from initial Transition\-In discovery through Core Development, Integration, Go\-Live, Hypercare, and into steady\-state Operations \& Maintenance.  

This role leads discovery activities during Transition\-In, including structured knowledge\-transfer sessions with the incumbent O\&M vendor, to capture existing system functionality, clarify ambiguous or undocumented requirements, and identify gaps between current capabilities and Government objectives, and works closely with the Project Manager, Technical Lead, UI/UX Specialist, and Product Owner to build and continuously refine the product backlog so that user stories are prioritized by business value and technical dependency and contain complete, testable acceptance criteria.  

The Business Analyst reviews wireframes and UX mockups developed by the UI/UX Specialist against documented requirements to confirm alignment prior to Product Owner approval, and remains actively engaged throughout each sprint to validate that delivered functionality satisfies the documented business requirements and acceptance criteria prior to story completion, reviewing developed features against the original requirement intent, participating in sprint reviews and UAT sessions to confirm correct implementation of business rules and DER/edit\-test logic, and identifying and reporting discrepancies between delivered functionality and specified requirements.  

The Business Analyst maintains end\-to\-end requirements traceability (Roadmap User Stories Tasks Test Results) across all annual rollover cycles, ensuring that as the system evolves — through new epics, annual forms changes, and post\-go\-live enhancements — validated requirements remain accurate and any implementation drift is caught and corrected, and serves as the ongoing liaison between EBSA/OCIO business stakeholders and the technical development team for the life of the contract.  

Experience/Qualifications* Undergraduate college degree from an accredited college or university in business administration, information systems, computer science, or related discipline, or equivalent experience

* At least 6 years of experience performing business analysis, requirements gathering, and documentation for IT application development projects

* At least 3 years of experience working within an Agile/Scrum environment, writing and refining user stories, epics, and acceptance criteria

* Experience validating delivered functionality against documented business requirements and acceptance criteria, including UAT support and sprint review participation, prior to Government sign\-off

* Experience conducting stakeholder meetings, facilitating requirements workshops, and leading knowledge\-transfer or discovery sessions with incumbent contractors or legacy system owners

* Experience translating business and regulatory requirements (e.g., ERISA, Form 5500 series filing requirements) into functional specifications and system design inputs

* Experience with Jira for requirements traceability and backlog management, and with Confluence and Microsoft SharePoint for organizing project documentation and requirements artifacts

* Experience reviewing wireframes and UX mockups against documented requirements to confirm alignment prior to Product Owner approval

* Working knowledge of federal IT development processes, including Section 508 accessibility requirements and information security considerations.

* Experience supporting annual system change cycles, including analyzing legislative or regulatory changes for system impact and validating that rollover implementations match specified requirements

**Position Overview**
Mission One is seeking a Mid\-Level Cyber Intelligence Analyst,who is familiar with the space domain,to conduct all\-source intelligence analysis of foreign cyber capabilities, operations, and threats. The analyst will assess adversary cyber doctrine, strategy, tactics, techniques and procedures (TTPs), infrastructure, vulnerabilities, emerging technologies, and offensive and defensive capabilities. The role supports cyber operations, network defense, threat assessments, mission assurance, and operational decision\-making while performing cross\-functional duties across Intelligence Requirements Coordination (IRC), Intelligence Mission Integration, and Intelligence Analysis.  

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Cyber \& Intelligence Analysis:
	+ Analyze cyber programs and activities intended to compromise, disrupt, degrade, or neutralize U.S. and allied information systems and networks.
	+ Develop cyber threat, threat capability, and vulnerability assessments affecting space, ground, and information environments.
	+ Assess adversary capabilities, vulnerabilities, intent, and potential mission impacts using intelligence from across the Intelligence Community (IC).
	+ Produce and disseminate decision\-quality intelligence products and senior\-level analytic assessments.
	+ Conduct red\-team, alternative\-futures, and other structured analytic activities to identify risk, challenge assumptions, and support mission planning.
	+ Maintain intelligence tools, dashboards, production schedules, and analytic workflows, incorporating IC feedback to improve product relevance and operational value.
* Intelligence Requirements Coordination (IRC):
	+ Develop and refine Priority Intelligence Requirements (PIRs) and manage Requests for Information (RFIs).
	+ Coordinate, track, deconflict, and advocate intelligence requirements across IC partners and stakeholders.
	+ Identify collection and analytic gaps, facilitate intelligence access, and support requirements coordination.
	+ Support crisis planning, CONOP development, intelligence annexes, wargaming, and intelligence dashboard management.
* Intelligence Mission Integration:
	+ Develop and maintain space\-based threat estimates using Joint Intelligence Preparation of the Operational Environment (JIPOE).
	+ Produce time\-sensitive intelligence and data\-driven threat analytics in support of mission and operational requirements.
	+ Coordinate collection strategies and maintain situational awareness through intelligence tools and dashboards.
	+ Connect organizations with appropriate IC partners, subject\-matter experts, and analytic resources.
	+ Provide intelligence support to acquisition, exercises, crisis response, continuity operations, counterspace missions, anomaly resolution, and emergency response.

**Required Qualifications**
* Minimum of eight (8\) years of relevant professional experience supporting cyber\-related missions, intelligence analysis, space operations, or activities.
* Bachelor’s degree in a related field.
* Demonstrated experience developing decision\-quality materials, including strategic papers, options analyses, executive briefings, and executive action\-tracking products.
* Demonstrated knowledge in Intelligence Requirements Coordination, Intelligence Mission Integration, and Intelligence Analysis.
* Active security clearance required; clearance level will be determined by contract requirements.

**Desired Qualifications**
* Comprehensive mission knowledge supported by relevant developmental training and professional experience.
* Ability to derive and clearly communicate analytic judgments from incomplete, indirect, highly complex, seemingly unrelated, or technically advanced information.
* Ability to structure analytic work using trends in reporting and perspectives from multiple analysts, organizations, and intelligence disciplines.
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate across the IC on information sharing, collection requirements, analytic coordination, and resolution of competing perspectives.
* Ability to develop concise, insightful, and comprehensive defense intelligence products for operational and senior\-level audiences.
* Demonstrated ability to lead or contribute to teams researching multifaceted, complex, or mission\-critical problems.

-------------------

jobs.description:
##### **About Peraton**


Peraton is a next\-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.


##### **Program Overview**


The program is an IDIQ contract for an AWS\-based cloud hosting system. Currently, Peraton is supporting the Cloud Security, IoT, and AIML use cases for the environment in a hybrid work environment with Federal employees. Peraton also support the following applications as part of the environment: Dremio, Tableau, Globus, Posit/RStudio, Atlassian, ThingLogix, Alteryx and CloudCheckr.
##### **About The Role**


Peraton's Department of the Interior (DOI), U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service (FWS), and NOAA's National Marine Fisheries Service (NMFS) have identified a critical gap in the federal government's ability to conduct comprehensive Endangered Species Act (ESA) research. While FWS operates an authoritative web\-based platform for managing data for terrestrial and freshwater species, it does not currently include NMFS marine and anadromous species data forcing agencies to rely on separate, manual processes. This program closes that gap by integrating marine and anadromous species data into the existing FWS platform, creating a single, unified experience for all ESA\-listed species.

  

Peraton is seeking a **Lead Business Analyst** to serve as the senior BA lead on a federal environmental data integration program. In this role, you will bring expertise in Endangered Species Act \- Section 7 consultation processes and federal environmental platform workflows to drive requirements, compliance validation, and cross\-agency coordination at the highest level.

  

**Work Location:** Remote

  

**Roles and Responsibilities**


* Serve as the senior business analysis lead across the full project, providing SME\-level expertise in Endangered Species Act \- Section 7 consultation processes, platform workflows, and multi\-agency coordination
* Lead requirements elicitation and documentation for all platform changes including species display, decision logic updates, template updates, and consultation routing
* Conduct gap analysis between current platform capabilities and integration requirements, documenting findings for technical deliverables
* Facilitate joint requirements workshops with the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service (FWS) Ecological Services and NOAA Fisheries SMEs
* Lead the development of consultation logic alignment documentation for joint agency use
* Support compliance validation by verifying that species list generation, decision logic, template content, and consultation routing meet regulatory requirements
* Coordinate with government SMEs to obtain required approvals and sign\-offs on compliance\-critical deliverables
* Lead pilot consultation workflow design, defining scenarios covering all consultation types
* Analyze pilot results and live consultation feedback, translating findings into actionable system updates
* Lead the development of the Pilot Report with Metrics, capturing consultation cycle times, completion rates, defect summaries, and actionable findings from pilot workflow execution
* Lead the development of the Endangered Species Act \- Section 7 Compliance Validation Checklist, documenting validation criteria for species list generation accuracy, decision logic correctness, template content completeness, and consultation routing
* Coordinate government review and acceptance of Updated DKeys and Consultation Package Builder Assets, ensuring all content meets regulatory requirements and agency sign\-off is obtained
* Contribute to final operational documentation and year\-end reporting
##### **Qualifications**


**Basic Qualifications**


* Bachelors degree and 10 years professional experience or a Masters degree and 8 years professional experience or an Associates degree and 12 years professional experience; or a high school diploma/equivalent and 16 years’ professional experience.
* U.S. Citizenship required; must have the ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance
* Extensive years of business analysis experience on federal IT programs
* Expertise in Endangered Species Act \- Section 7 consultation processes
* Experience with federal environmental regulatory systems and multi\-agency coordination
* Strong requirements elicitation, documentation, and stakeholder facilitation skills
* Experience supporting compliance validation activities on federal programs
* Experience capturing and reporting pilot metrics including cycle times, completion rates, and defect summaries
* Experience facilitating OMB or executive\-level government reviews and demonstration preparation

**Preferred Qualifications**


* CBAP or equivalent BA certification preferred
* Direct experience with the FWS Information for Planning and Consultation (IPaC) platform, Ecological Services, or NOAA Fisheries systems
* Experience with DOI, FWS, or NOAA Fisheries programs
* Familiarity with data migration or system integration projects in a federal context
* Active Public Trust Clearance

Iron EagleX (IEX), a wholly owned subsidiary of General Dynamics Information Technology (GDIT), delivers agile IT and Intelligence solutions. Combining small\-team flexibility with global scale, IEX leverages emerging technologies to provide innovative, user\-focused solutions that empower organizations and end users to operate smarter, faster, and more securely in dynamic environments.

Iron EagleX is seeking a Senior Principal Intelligence Analyst to support our analytics teams in Crystal City, VA. In this role, you will conduct advanced all\-source analysis while working closely with multi\-discipline analysts, data scientists, data engineers, and developers to improve the speed, depth, and quality of analytic production. * Conduct expert\-level all\-source analysis using structured analytic techniques, intelligence tradecraft, and multiple information sources to produce defensible assessments, insights, and recommendations.
* Analyze complex datasets, reporting streams, operational information, and mission\-relevant source material to identify patterns, trends, anomalies, relationships, risks, and intelligence gaps.

* Support the development of analytic methodologies that combine traditional all\-source tradecraft with data\-driven techniques, automated discovery, knowledge management, and AI\-assisted analysis.
* Identify data gaps, quality issues, source limitations, collection shortfalls, and analytic constraints that affect the reliability of assessments or technical outputs.
* Produce written assessments, briefings, analytic notes, and decision\-support products tailored to mission, operational, and technical stakeholders.
* Collaborate with full stack developers and data engineers to ensure analytic workflows, tool interfaces, and data access patterns support realistic analyst needs without assuming responsibility for software development or front\-end implementation.
* Apply rigorous sourcing, confidence levels, assumptions, alternative analysis, and evidence evaluation to ensure analytic products are transparent, credible, and defensible.
* Support the integration of AI\-enabled tools into analytic workflows by testing outputs, identifying failure modes, refining prompts or analytic use cases, and documenting appropriate use cases and limitations.

jobs.description:

We provide long\-term growth and development. Headquartered in Colorado, I2X is engaged in programs across the country and in more than 20 states. Our programs support multiple Federal agencies, the Department of Defense and often focused on the space initiatives of our government customers. **I2X Technologies is seeking a Senior Information System Security Manager (ISSM)** to support ongoing activities for a customer in Odenton, MD. **This position will be** **on\-site** **and will require an active Secret clearance.*** Manage the Risk Management Framework (RMF) lifecycle for supported systems enabling the achievement and continued maintenance of Authority to Operate (ATO) accreditation.
* Provide ISSM, FISMA, and certification and accreditation support for systems and associated components.
* Conduct recurring assessments of security controls and documentation in eMASS and PPSM to verify continued accuracy, compliance, and readiness.
* Manage whitelist records, address vulnerabilities identified through recurring IAVMS scans, and develop Plans of Action and Milestones (POA\&Ms) when required.
* Maintain eMASS control records and POA\&Ms in accordance with ATO conditions, approval requirements, and remediation timelines.
* Coordinate cybersecurity activities supporting interim and final authorization to test and operate, including assessments, mitigation planning, patch validation, implementation tracking, and status reporting.
* Create and deliver cybersecurity test plans, test reports, implementation plans, security technical configuration documentation, vulnerability assessment reports, and authorization package materials.
* Lead cybersecurity governance and reporting activities, including the development and maintenance of system architectures, requirements, security plans, protection plans, IAVA actions, and IA\-related objectives.
* Prepare program documentation, evidence, and briefings for DISA OAB reviews and support the team throughout the review process.


Qualifications:
* Bachelor’s Degree with 8\+ years of experience or Master’s degree with 6\+ years of experience. Additional experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
* CISSP (Certified Information Systems Security Professional), CISM (Certified Information Security Manager), or similar cybersecurity certification.
* In\-depth knowledge of DoD cybersecurity policies, frameworks, and compliance standards (e.g., NIST 800\-53, RMF, FISMA, ICD 503, JSIG).
* In\-depth experience with network systems and building/maintaining an ATO for enterprise computing information systems.
* Experience with system security engineering, risk management, and vulnerability assessments.
* Strong understanding of network security, security controls, and common cybersecurity tools (e.g., firewalls, IDS/IPS, SIEM, endpoint protection).
* Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams.
* Strong communication skills, including the ability to create and present detailed security reports to stakeholders.
* Clearance: US **Secret** clearance required

**Preferred Qualifications:*** Experience in managing security for complex DoD programs or mission\-critical systems.
* Experience with security tools for vulnerability scanning, penetration testing, and security auditing.
* Advanced security certifications (e.g., CISA, CEH, CSSP, etc.).
* Experience with configuration management and change management processes in a secure environment.
* Experience with automation and the continuous ATO (cATO) process.

**Additional Information:**  

In compliance with Colorado’s Equal Pay for Equal Work Act, the annual base salary range for this position is listed. Please note that the salary information is a general guideline only. I2X Technologies considers factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate’s work experience, education/training, key skills, internal peer equity, as well as, market and business considerations when extending an offer.  

Physical Demands:


The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job with or without reasonable accommodation.

  

While performing the duties of this job, the employee will regularly sit, walk, stand and climb stairs and steps. May require walking long distance from parking to work station. Occasionally, movement that requires twisting at the neck and/or trunk more than the average person, squatting/ stooping/kneeling, reaching above the head, and forward motion will be required. The employee will continuously be required to repeat the same hand, arm, or finger motion many times. Manual and finger dexterity are essential to this position. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close, distance, depth perception and telling differences among colors. The employee must be able to communicate through speech with clients and public. Hearing requirements include conversation in both quiet and noisy environments. Lifting may require floor to waist, waist to shoulder, or shoulder to overhead movement of up to 20 pounds. This position demands tolerance for various levels of mental stress.

Dcode is a team of doers dedicated to bridging the gap between the speed of technology and the federal government. We align people, culture, policies, and processes to get tech in the hands of those who need it most. jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
As a leader in Lawful and Location Intelligence, SS8 helps make societies safer. Our commitment is to extract, analyze, and visualize the critical intelligence that gives law enforcement, intelligence agencies, and emergency services the real\-time insights that help save lives. Our high performance, flexible, and future\-proof solutions also enable mobile network operators to achieve regulatory compliance with minimum disruption, time, and cost. SS8 is trusted by the largest government agencies, communications providers, and systems integrators globally.

**Overview**



We are seeking a Senior Project Manager to join our team and to support the full lifecycle of U.S. Government opportunities and programs—from early customer engagement and proposal development through contracting, project execution, customer adoption, and long\-term relationship management.  

This role will serve as a critical bridge between SS8's Government Sales organization, customers, partners, Engineering, Product Management, Contracts, and other internal stakeholders. The ideal candidate combines strong program management and communication skills with experience supporting government customers, bids and proposals, contracts, and technology\-driven programs.  

Depending on project demands, the role may spend significant periods supporting the sales process but will transition to project / program delivery as their core function and priority when required.  

This individual does not need to be a telecommunications engineer but must be technically savvy, comfortable learning complex software and technology environments, and capable of translating between technical teams, business stakeholders, and government customers.


**Key Responsibilities**


**Project \& Program Execution**


* Lead cross\-functional teams responsible for the successful deployment, integration, testing, acceptance, and operationalization of SS8 software and services.
* Develop and maintain detailed project plans with clearly defined milestones, responsibilities, dependencies, and deliverables.
* Manage project risks, issues, schedules, resources, dependencies, and mitigation plans.
* Manage the requirements lifecycle and ensure alignment between customer expectations, contractual commitments, and technical implementation.
* Coordinate acceptance testing and ensure completion of contractual deliverables and customer acceptance criteria.
* Manage project scope and support the development and execution of change requests when requirements evolve.
* Provide regular program status updates to customers and SS8 leadership.
* Follow established program governance, schedules, responsibilities, communication plans, and internal/customer reporting processes.
* Track contract deliverables, modifications, funding actions, option periods, and other milestones that may impact program execution.
* Conduct lessons\-learned sessions and track resulting actions in order to incorporate findings into future programs and proposals.


**Customer Success \& Relationship Management**


* Serve as a primary point of coordination for customers throughout program execution.
* Maintain regular communication with government stakeholders to ensure visibility into progress, risks, decisions, and upcoming milestones.
* Work proactively to identify and resolve customer concerns before they impact program success.
* Help customers understand SS8 capabilities and identify opportunities to increase utilization or apply SS8 technology to additional mission requirements.
* Partner with Sales leadership to support account planning, follow\-on opportunities, contract renewals, and program expansion.
* Maintain awareness of customer priorities, funding cycles, procurement activities, and organizational changes that may affect the program or broader account.


**Contract \& Program Transition**


* Support the transition of awarded opportunities from Sales and Capture into formal project / program execution.
* Review contract requirements, Statements of Work, deliverables, milestones, reporting obligations, and acceptance criteria.
* Coordinate with Contracts, Finance, Engineering, Product, Sales, and partners to ensure contractual and operational requirements are understood.


**Government Opportunity \& Customer Support**


* Support Government Sales leadership throughout the opportunity lifecycle, from initial customer engagement through contract award and execution.
* Assist in preparing customer communications, capability briefs, white papers, presentations, meeting materials, and follow\-up actions.
* Participate in customer discovery sessions to understand mission requirements, operational challenges, technical environments, procurement considerations, and desired outcomes.
* Maintain continuity between pre\-award customer conversations and post\-award execution to ensure commitments and requirements are understood and delivered.
* Develop trusted relationships with government customers, industry partners, integrators, and other program stakeholders.
* Identify follow\-on requirements, expansion opportunities, and emerging customer needs during program execution.


**Capture, Bid \& Proposal Support**


* Coordinate and support responses to RFIs, RFQs, RFPs, solution briefs, Sources Sought notices, and other government acquisition activities.
* Manage proposal schedules, compliance matrices, action items, contributors, reviews, and submission requirements.
* Work with Sales, Engineering, Product Management, Contracts, and partners to translate customer requirements into executable technical and programmatic solutions.
* Support development and review of Statements of Work, technical approaches, implementation plans, schedules, deliverables, assumptions, and acceptance criteria.
* Maintain reusable proposal content, past performance information, program documentation, and other government business collateral.
* Help ensure commitments made during the sales and proposal process

jobs.description:
We are building a governance, risk, and compliance function to enable our company to buildproducts that can withstand regulatory scrutiny, and ensure Meta continues to meet globalregulatory requirements and manage risk. Meta's Risk and Compliance Program (RCP) is the central engine driving risk management and compliance at the company, supporting Meta and the family of apps. Within RCP, the Security Risk Program (SRP) is the second\-line function accountable for how Meta identifies, assesses, quantifies, and reports its security risk posture — delivering global security risk assessments, Capability Maturity \& Effectiveness (CME) evaluations, AI and cloud risk assessments, and board\-level and regulatory reporting.We are seeking a Security Risk Program Manager to build one of the program's highest\-priority new capabilities: security risk assessment of AI product launches. Today, AI launches receivead\-hoc coverage through security risk assessments designed for infrastructure — not forproduct\-launch cadence, and not for cross\-domain AI risk spanning Security, Privacy, Integrity,and Legal. You will design that capability from the ground up and scale it from roughly fiveassessments per quarter today to twenty or more per quarter by H1 2027, in step with Meta's AIproduct velocity.This is a builder and an influencer role in equal measure. AI launch risk cannot beassessed by one function acting alone — it requires Central Security, product groups, Privacy,Integrity, and Legal moving through a shared process on a launch timeline. You will own thatoperating model: translating product and engineering reality into a defensible risk position, andtranslating regulatory obligation into assessment work that product teams can actually absorbwithout stalling a launch. The ideal candidate is comfortable with ambiguity, effective inhigh\-pressure and fast\-moving situations, and able to build durable relationships across a widerange of technical and non\-technical stakeholders.

* Build and maintain a consolidated AI risk register that gives leadership a single view of.

jobs.description:
**About Radiant**
-----------------


Radiant is an El Segundo, CA\-based startup building the world’s first mass\-produced, portable nuclear microreactors. The company’s first reactor, Kaleidos, is a 1\-megawatt, fail\-safe microreactor that can be transported anywhere power is needed and run for up to 5 years without refueling. Portable nuclear power with rapid\-deploy capability can replace similar\-sized diesel generators and provide critical asset support for hospitals, data centers, remote sites, and military bases. Radiant’s unique, practical approach to nuclear development leverages modern software engineering to rapidly deliver safe, factory\-built microreactors that use existing, well\-qualified materials. Founded in 2020, Radiant is on track to test its first reactor at the Idaho National Laboratory this summer, with initial customer deliveries beginning in 2028\.

  

About the Role


Radiant is seeking a talented Technical Program Manager, IT \& Security, to own visibility and delivery across our IT and security program portfolio. You will track eight concurrent programs spanning three states: a reactor program at Idaho National Laboratory; a fuel facility and manufacturing plant in Tennessee; warehouse and office buildouts in Los Angeles; a site decommissioning; and a CMMC and NIST SP 800\-171 compliance program running across all of it.


We have strong technical leaders on each effort. What we don't have is one person who can see the whole portfolio at once, keep it visible, and ensure teams meet commitments. In this role, you won't write the SSP or design the network. You'll make sure the people doing that work are aligned, unblocked, and delivering against a schedule everyone can see. WHO WE ARE:  

Headquartered in Southern California, Skechers—the Comfort Technology Company®—has spent over 30 years helping men, women, and kids everywhere look and feel good. ABOUT THE ROLE:  

A Cybersecurity Analyst at Skechers is a key member of our global cybersecurity team. This role places you at the front lines of our cyber defense practice, where you will lead complex investigations, liaison with senior security resources, and serve as a primary point of contact for our global security partners. While incident handling and response are central to the role, our Cybersecurity Analysts also provide meaningful input into our threat intelligence practice and support proactive security work, including threat hunting and vulnerability management, to strengthen the organization’s overall security posture.
  

  

This is an excellent opportunity for an analyst who has built a solid foundation in Tier 1 alert triage and is ready to take ownership of higher\-complexity work with greater independence. The role is especially well suited for someone who wants to join an agile cybersecurity team that values innovation and a continuous improvement mindset. The candidate who will find the most success and fulfillment brings a genuine interest and passion for cybersecurity, a love for learning, a positive attitude, and a desire to roll up their sleeves and dive into the deep end.
WHAT YOU'LL DO:

* Proactively monitor tools, feeds, and dashboards for security alerts.
* Identify and triage alerts from internal systems and respond to alerts from managed SOC providers.
* Follow established process while responding to incidents and preparing reports.
* Lead complex, multi\-system security investigations from initial signal through containment recommendations, remediation, and written findings.
* Correlate telemetry across endpoint, identity provider, email, SaaS, cloud, network, and other data to determine what happened, what was affected, and what action is required.
* Use AI/LLM assistants for triage, enrichment, log summarization, timeline development, and detection drafting while validating outputs against source evidence and recognizing hallucinated or incomplete analysis.
* Identify opportunities to improve SOC processes, detections, and workflows, including recommending where AI, automation, or playbook enhancements could reduce manual effort, improve consistency, or accelerate response.

* Provide input to and report on metrics for alerts, incidents, responses, and operations.
* Assess managed SOC escalations for quality, urgency, and completeness; provide feedback that improves escalation criteria and alert fidelity.
* Work closely with multiple groups and business units globally to provide guidance and support.
* Work closely with internal stakeholders and managed security partners to respond to alerts and incidents and escalate as necessary.
* Stay current with the evolving threat landscape, defensive capabilities, and relevant security tools and techniques, including AI\-assisted analysis, automation, and emerging attacker tradecraft.
* Conduct threat hunts leveraging threat intelligence to proactively identify, investigate, and remediate emerging security threats across the organization.
* Participate in purple team exercises, combining offensive and defensive tactics to strengthen the organization's security posture, enhance threat detection and improve incident response capabilities.
* Analyze vulnerabilities and exposure signals in context of exploitability, asset criticality, compensating controls, and observed threat activity to help prioritize remediation.

* Experience working with servers or workstations running Windows, Linux, or OS X.
* Experience investigating, securing, or supporting cloud systems, platforms, and resources.
* Experience with security tools like EDR, SIEM, etc.
* Understanding of cybersecurity concepts and emerging threats.
* Experience in phishing and malware analysis.
* Strong documentation habits with excellent written and oral communication skills.
* Strong work ethic with attention to detail.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently on complex threat analysis and alert triage while maintaining accuracy and efficiency.
* Ability to excel in a fast paced and rapidly changing environment.


REQUIREMENTS:

* Strong working knowledge of cybersecurity operations, incident response, and the technologies commonly used to investigate and contain security events.
* 2\+ years of experience working hands on in a cybersecurity focused role preferred.
* GIAC, (ISC)2, or other relevant security certifications a plus.

jobs.title: Marketing Program Manager V
jobs.description:
**Overview:** Kaiser Permanente\-s National Marketing team is reshaping how our brand shows up across audiences, markets, and channels. As a Program Manager V supporting the **Brand Marketing** team, you will lead end\-to\-end brand transformation initiatives from discovery through launch, coordinating cross\-functional teams across KP and our agency partners. You will align business objectives, establish governance frameworks, and manage timelines, budgets, and risks to ensure successful execution. You will also lead internal rollout and change\-management efforts to drive consistent adoption of the new brand across lines of business and channels, and track performance through agreed\-upon success metrics and reporting, bringing forward insights and recommendations to Brand leadership and the broader Marketing organization.
**Job Summary:**
Manages large\-scale programs or components with multiple workstreams and strategic business goals across departments, functions, or regions with responsibility and accountability for achieving program outcomes from initiation to close\-out in an extended or open\-ended time frame. Leads the work of large program teams by leading others in coordinating and monitoring internal and/or external resources. Proactively monitors, identifies, and mitigates program risks, issues, and trigger events by developing mitigation plans and strategies. Monitors compliance of program activities by ensuring program plans and team members adhere to relevant policies and procedures. Ensures the alignment, buy\-in, engagement, and support of diverse program stakeholders. Reviews vendor performance levels, ensures service level agreements are met, and participates in contract negotiations with vendors.

 **Essential Responsibilities:*** Promotes learning in others by communicating information and providing advice to drive projects forward; builds relationships with cross\-functional stakeholders. Listens, responds to, seeks, and addresses performance feedback; provides actionable feedback to others, including upward feedback to leadership and mentors junior team members. Practices self\-leadership; creates and executes plans to capitalize on strengths and improve opportunity areas; influences team members within assigned team or unit. Adapts to competing demands and new responsibilities; adapts to and learns from change, challenges, and feedback. Models team collaboration within and across teams.
* Conducts or oversees business\-specific projects by applying deep expertise in subject area; promotes adherence to all procedures and policies. Partners internally and externally to make effective business decisions; determines and carries out processes and methodologies; solves complex problems; escalates high\-priority issues or risks, as appropriate; monitors progress and results. Develops work plans to meet business priorities and deadlines; coordinates and delegates resources to accomplish organizational goals. Recognizes and capitalizes on improvement opportunities; evaluates recommendations made; influences the completion of project tasks by others.
* Manages large\-scale programs or components with multiple workstreams and strategic business goals across departments, functions, or regions with responsibility and accountability for achieving program outcomes from initiation to close\-out in an extended or open ended time frame. Develops, analyzes, and manages highly complex program plans which include scope identification and management, schedule, inter\-dependencies, and resource forecast. Manages and monitors the program financials of large\-scale programs. Monitors program performance to ensure programs effectively deliver maximum long term value or benefit to the organization, and makes adjustments as needed in an uncertain environment where scope may be fluid. Leads program activities related to organizational change management (e.g., development and execution of user adoption, implementation, and training plans) as defined by the program. Drives allocation of resources, establishes schedules, and task assignments to ensure established program management practices are in place. This role may perform project management duties in addition to program management responsibilities.
* Leads the work of large program teams by monitoring internal and external resources. Leads others in requesting and coordinating internal and/ or external resources based on the alignment of team member skills and program demands. Communicates a clear vision of program goals and objectives to the team. Delivers performance feedback to team members supervisors.
* Proactively monitors, identifies, and mitigates program risks, issues, and trigger events by developing mitigation plans and strategies; and resolving or escalating risks or issues as appropriate.
* Monitors adherence of program activities to policies and procedures by ensuring program plans and team members follow KP, departmental, and/or business line policies and procedures.
* Ensures the alignment, buy\-in, engagement and support of diverse program stakeholders by building and maintaining relationships as well as communicating appropriately with internal customers, third party vendors, senior management, and business leaders; and clarifying accountability and authority across stakeholders. Identifies and works closely with key stakeholders based on their level of influence and decision making and ensures all appropriate stakeholders are represented and included. Communicates tough issues to stakeholders while maintaining an independent opinion, providing recommendations, delivering formal presentations, and providing reports to various senior audiences.

jobs.description:
Founded in 1977 as the Senior Care Action Network, SCAN began with a simple but radical idea: that older adults deserve to stay healthy and independent. That belief was championed by a group of community activists we still honor today as the “12 Angry Seniors.” Their mission continues to guide everything we do.


Today, SCAN is a nonprofit health organization serving more than 500,000 people across Arizona, California, Nevada, New Mexico, Texas, and Washington, with over $8 billion in annual revenue. With nearly five decades of experience, we have built a distinctive, values\-driven platform dedicated to improving care for older adults.


Our work spans Medicare Advantage, fully integrated care models, primary care, care for the most medically and socially complex populations, and next\-generation care delivery models. Across all of this, we are united by a shared commitment: combining compassion with discipline, innovation with stewardship, and growth with integrity.


At SCAN, we believe scale should strengthen—not dilute—our mission. We are building the future of care for older adults, grounded in purpose, accountability, and respect for the people and communities we serve.

jobs.title: Project Manager - Housing Element Services
jobs.description:
BKF is a multi\-service infrastructure consulting firm providing civil engineering, construction management, environmental, planning, and surveying services across California, the Pacific Northwest, and beyond. With offices throughout California and the Portland area, BKF has served transportation, water resources, land development, government, and federal clients for over 110 years.


At BKF, you’ll find a unique opportunity to grow your career with intention. Our culture values professional autonomy, innovation, and meaningful collaboration across offices. We are proud to be recognized with the Great Place to Work certification for the second year in a row.


The Project Manager – Housing Element Services leads project delivery and business development for Housing Element work within the Community Planning practice. This role reports to the Community Planning Practice Lead and is responsible for driving the firm’s growth in 7th cycle Housing Element updates and implementation, building on a track record of 6th cycle delivery. The Project Manager should have hands\-on experience managing Housing Element updates from background analysis through HCD certification, along with a working knowledge of RHNA methodology, site inventory requirements, rezoning programs, and affirmatively furthering fair housing (AFFH) analysis.


This is a seller\-doer role. The Project Manager will manage a portfolio of Housing Element projects while also leading the identification, pursuit, and capture of new 7th cycle opportunities, working closely with the Practice Lead on pipeline strategy and proposal development.

**Responsibilities**

**Project Management \& Delivery:**

* Serve as Project Manager on Housing Element update and implementation projects, including background reports, site inventories, program development, rezoning, and public engagement through HCD certification.
* Manage project scope, schedule, budget, and subconsultant coordination to ensure quality delivery and client satisfaction.
* Guide clients through HCD review cycles and evolving state housing law requirements.
* Coordinate with multidisciplinary internal teams across planning, environmental, and engineering disciplines.

**Business Development \& Pursuit Leadership:**

* Lead the firm’s strategy for identifying and pursuing 7th cycle Housing Element opportunities, with a focus on the Bay Area and LA metro markets.
* Track upcoming Housing Element RFP releases and position the firm ahead of key pursuits.
* Lead proposal development and RFP responses, partnering with the Practice Lead and Business Development team on go\-to\-market strategy.
* Build and maintain relationships with city and county planning staff, HCD, and housing stakeholders.
* Contribute to the achievement of overall Planning sector sales and booking goals.

**Community Engagement:**

* Lead public outreach and engagement efforts for Housing Element updates, including community workshops, stakeholder meetings, and public hearings.
* Develop accessible outreach materials that clearly communicate housing policy and program concepts to diverse communities.
* Apply an equity lens to engagement strategy, consistent with AFFH requirements.

**Client Engagement:**

* Serve as a key point of contact for project clients, maintaining strong relationships and proactively addressing client needs.
* Represent the firm at local industry events, conferences, and public agency meetings.

**Collaboration \& Team Development:**

* Work collaboratively with the broader Community Planning team and other service lines, including Resiliency, Environmental Compliance, and Housing.
* Support mentorship and professional development of junior staff, with a path toward supervising direct reports as the Housing Element portfolio grows.
* Promote a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.

  

**Requirements**  

* Minimum of 5–7 years of experience in community planning, with a focus on Housing Element preparation and implementation.
* Demonstrated experience serving as Project Manager or a lead team member on at least one 6th cycle (2021–2029\) Housing Element update.
* Working knowledge of RHNA methodology, site inventory requirements, rezoning programs, and AFFH analysis.
* Demonstrated experience contributing to business development, including proposals, RFP responses, and client presentations; prior seller\-doer experience preferred.
* Strong community engagement skills, with experience facilitating public meetings and developing outreach materials.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to present complex housing policy topics clearly to technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Highly organized and able to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast\-paced consulting environment.
* Remote/hybrid position; candidates established in the Bay Area or LA metro area are preferred.
* Willingness to travel as needed to support project sites, client meetings, and regional offices.
* Bachelor’s degree in Urban Planning, Public Policy, or a closely related field is required.
* AICP certification is preferred.


Physical Demands: Must be able to regularly talk, hear and operate a computer, keyboard and mouse and occasionally lift, pull/push and carry up to 20 pounds with accommodations.


Work Conditions: Exposure to constant or intermittent sounds at a low or moderate level consistent with an office setting. Exposure to high\-stress, fast\-paced, deadline\-oriented environment. Travel to other BKF locations and client sites may be required.

 **Benefits**  

* The typical base salary range for this position is $139,744\.8 \- $170,799\.2 annualized depending upon skills, experience, education, and geographical location. This is a salary position paid biweekly.
* Competitive salaries, profit sharing, and 401k.
* Generous paid time off packages.
* 9 Paid Holidays.
* Flexible schedules.
* Education reimbursement, paid annual dues for professional

At BKF, you’ll find a unique opportunity to grow your career with intention. Our culture values professional autonomy, innovation, and meaningful collaboration across offices. We are proud to be recognized with the Great Place to Work certification for the second year in a row.


The Project Manager – Housing Element Services leads project delivery and business development for Housing Element work within the Community Planning practice. This role reports to the Community Planning Practice Lead and is responsible for driving the firm’s growth in 7th cycle Housing Element updates and implementation, building on a track record of 6th cycle delivery. The Project Manager should have hands\-on experience managing Housing Element updates from background analysis through HCD certification, along with a working knowledge of RHNA methodology, site inventory requirements, rezoning programs, and affirmatively furthering fair housing (AFFH) analysis.


This is a seller\-doer role. The Project Manager will manage a portfolio of Housing Element projects while also leading the identification, pursuit, and capture of new 7th cycle opportunities, working closely with the Practice Lead on pipeline strategy and proposal development.

**Responsibilities**

**Project Management \& Delivery:**

* Serve as Project Manager on Housing Element update and implementation projects, including background reports, site inventories, program development, rezoning, and public engagement through HCD certification.
* Manage project scope, schedule, budget, and subconsultant coordination to ensure quality delivery and client satisfaction.
* Guide clients through HCD review cycles and evolving state housing law requirements.
* Coordinate with multidisciplinary internal teams across planning, environmental, and engineering disciplines.

**Business Development \& Pursuit Leadership:**

* Lead the firm’s strategy for identifying and pursuing 7th cycle Housing Element opportunities, with a focus on the Bay Area and LA metro markets.
* Track upcoming Housing Element RFP releases and position the firm ahead of key pursuits.
* Lead proposal development and RFP responses, partnering with the Practice Lead and Business Development team on go\-to\-market strategy.
* Build and maintain relationships with city and county planning staff, HCD, and housing stakeholders.
* Contribute to the achievement of overall Planning sector sales and booking goals.

**Community Engagement:**

* Lead public outreach and engagement efforts for Housing Element updates, including community workshops, stakeholder meetings, and public hearings.
* Develop accessible outreach materials that clearly communicate housing policy and program concepts to diverse communities.
* Apply an equity lens to engagement strategy, consistent with AFFH requirements.

**Client Engagement:**

* Serve as a key point of contact for project clients, maintaining strong relationships and proactively addressing client needs.
* Represent the firm at local industry events, conferences, and public agency meetings.

**Collaboration \& Team Development:**

* Work collaboratively with the broader Community Planning team and other service lines, including Resiliency, Environmental Compliance, and Housing.
* Support mentorship and professional development of junior staff, with a path toward supervising direct reports as the Housing Element portfolio grows.
* Promote a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.

  

**Requirements**  

* Minimum of 5–7 years of experience in community planning, with a focus on Housing Element preparation and implementation.
* Demonstrated experience serving as Project Manager or a lead team member on at least one 6th cycle (2021–2029\) Housing Element update.
* Working knowledge of RHNA methodology, site inventory requirements, rezoning programs, and AFFH analysis.
* Demonstrated experience contributing to business development, including proposals, RFP responses, and client presentations; prior seller\-doer experience preferred.
* Strong community engagement skills, with experience facilitating public meetings and developing outreach materials.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to present complex housing policy topics clearly to technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Highly organized and able to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast\-paced consulting environment.
* Remote/hybrid position; candidates established in the Bay Area or LA metro area are preferred.
* Willingness to travel as needed to support project sites, client meetings, and regional offices.
* Bachelor’s degree in Urban Planning, Public Policy, or a closely related field is required.
* AICP certification is preferred.


Physical Demands: Must be able to regularly talk, hear and operate a computer, keyboard and mouse and occasionally lift, pull/push and carry up to 20 pounds with accommodations.


Work Conditions: Exposure to constant or intermittent sounds at a low or moderate level consistent with an office setting. Exposure to high\-stress, fast\-paced, deadline\-oriented environment. Travel to other BKF locations and client sites may be required.

 **Benefits**  

* The typical base salary range for this position is $139,744\.8 \- $170,799\.2 annualized depending upon skills, experience, education, and geographical location. This is a salary position paid biweekly.
* Competitive salaries, profit sharing, and 401k.
* Generous paid time off packages.
* 9 Paid Holidays.
* Flexible schedules.
* Education reimbursement, paid annual dues for professional

jobs.title: Principal Technical Program Manager — Partner GTM Systems & Technology
jobs.description:
**Overview**
------------


Role Overview
Intuit is undergoing a major transformation to modernize, unify, and scale our global partner ecosystem. The Global Partner Program (GPP) is our unified GTM framework designed to standardize enrollment, tiering, commercial benefits, and support experiences for all partner tracks—including Accountants, Value\-Added Resellers (VARs), Developers, and ISVs—under a single platform: the Intuit Partner Suite (IPS).  

As the Technical Program Manager for Partner GTM Systems \& Technology Roadmap, you will own the technical execution engine of this program. You will serve as the single operations interface into the data and systems engineering teams. Your mission is to translate high\-level program strategies into robust technical specifications, maintain and author all Business Requirements Documents (BRDs), manage the prioritization of the system roadmap, and aggressively mitigate technical risks to ensure flawless rollouts.

 **Responsibilities**

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* **Own the Technical Backlog \& Roadmap:** Drive the technical prioritization, sequencing, and delivery roadmap for the Intuit Partner Suite (PRM/Portal) and integrated GTM tools (Salesforce, DocuSign, Quickbase, and Varicent) in direct partnership with systems and engineering leaders.
* **Business Requirements (BRD) Authorship \& Lifecycle:** Author, update, and finalize comprehensive Business Requirements Documents (BRDs). You will translate complex partner strategies, multi\-tier revenue share structures, lead registration/protection rules, and tier\-aware support routing—into clear, implementation\-ready logic for developers.
* **Single Operations Interface to VEP/Engineering:** Act as the centralized point of contact for all technical requirements, unifying and streamlining communication channels to eliminate historical fragmentation between business, ops, and engineering.
* **Cross\-Functional Requirements Gathering:** Collaborate deeply with GPP Program Strategy to capture strategic intent, and PMO to map system dependencies, ensuring technical plans directly support GPP launch\-readiness schedules.
* **Technical Risk \& Blocker Mitigation:** Identify, track, and resolve system constraints and delivery risks. Focus areas include resolving data residency/GDPR requirements for international markets (UK, Canada, Australia) and managing the technical transition of legacy partner data into the new platform.
* **System Validation \& UAT Governance:** Define the operational quality standards and “Definition of Done” for technical deliverables. Lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and system validation to ensure shipped platform features exactly match defined business policies before they go live to partners.

 **Qualifications**

**Required Qualifications \& Experience**
-----------------------------------------

* **Systems Implementation Expertise:** 6\+ years of experience leading complex, large\-scale systems implementations across CRM (Salesforce/SFDC), Partner Relationship Management (PRM) platforms, Billing/Commerce engines, or Enterprise Data Warehouses.
* **Exceptional Business Analysis (BRD Writing):** A proven track record of writing exceptionally detailed, logic\-driven Business Requirements Documents (BRDs) that govern complex automation (e.g., tiered point accruals, referral payouts, and API\-driven data integrations).
* **Technical Translator:** Exceptional capability to bridge the gap between abstract business strategy and core engineering requirements, comfortably negotiating scope and trade\-offs with both Executive Directors and System Architects.
* **Cross\-Functional Collaborator:** Experience navigating highly matrixed enterprise organizations, with a demonstrated ability to align diverse stakeholder groups (Sales, Ops, Product, Success, Finance, and Legal).
* **Detail\-Oriented \& Risk\-Aware:** High analytical rigor with experience using structured risk\-management frameworks to identify operational constraints, system bugs, and process inefficiencies before they impact launch milestones.
* **Agile/Scrum Experience:** Strong familiarity with Agile delivery methodologies, backlog grooming, and Jira\-based sprint management.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience with PRM tools (e.g., Salesforce PRM, Impartner, ZiftONE).
* Familiarity with financial incentive systems (e.g., Varicent or automated revenue share platforms).
* Direct experience working within B2B SaaS partner programs, channel operations, or agency reseller ecosystems.

  

Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers \| Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.


The expected base pay range for this position is:
  

California Remote (Bay Area) $238,000\- $322,000  

California Remote (Not Bay Area) $219,500\- $297,000
