jobs.title: Senior Technical Compliance Program Manager, LCPO Solutions & Strategy
jobs.description:
**Overview**
------------


At Intuit, we help over 100 million people and businesses around the world feel more confident about their money. We are the proud makers of TurboTax, QuickBooks, Credit Karma, and Mailchimp. Our mission is to power prosperity around the world. We do this by staying customer\-obsessed and using data and AI to solve the biggest financial challenges for our customers.

  

The Legal, Compliance, Policy Organization’s Solutions \& Strategy team is looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to join our team. As technical program manager, you will be part of a smart, collaborative team focused on modernizing how Intuit's legal function operates, leverages data, automation, and AI. In this role you will work closely with legal operations, counsel, engineering, and other internal stakeholders across the business to identify opportunities where technology and AI\-powered tools can make LCPO faster, data driven, and more efficient while enabling the business.

 **Responsibilities**

* Serve as a technical translator and point of contact between Legal, Compliance and Policy Practice Groups and FLP Tech engineering — converting legal/business requirements and processes into clear technical requirements, user stories, and program plans that engineering can execute against.
* Partner directly with LCPO stakeholders across Legal Practice Groups to gather requirements, ask the right clarifying questions, and surface the true underlying need, not just the stated ask.
* Own end\-to\-end program delivery for prioritized Legal Tech initiatives (e.g., Unified Orchestration, workflow automation, AI\-assisted review tooling, CLM and data lake integrations), from planning through launch.
* Champion end user experience throughout the delivery lifecycle — pressure\-testing designs and workflows from the perspective of the legal/compliance practitioners,and business stakeholders who will actually use these tools day to day.
* Structure program delivery across engineering teams by applying strong SDLC knowledge — identifying workstreams, owners, dependencies, and risks before they materialize.
* Drive the operating rhythm for assigned programs: build and maintain plans with clear milestones and success measures, run status/risk reporting, and proactively escalate blockers with recommended paths to green.
* Build credibility with technical SMEs and engineering leads — understand solutions deeply enough to participate in architecture and trade\-off discussions, and communicate technical constraints back to legal/business stakeholders in plain language.
* Apply AI tools as thought partners to accelerate requirements analysis, documentation, and stakeholder communication, and help evaluate the quality and risk of AI\-assisted outputs.
* Support change management for new tools, workflows, and process redesigns — including stakeholder communication, training, and adoption tracking — to ensure LCPO teams actually adopt what FLP Tech ships.
* Contribute to and help scale program management best practices, tools, and templates across the Legal Tech program portfolio.
* Own clear from\-to metrics on intake so every request has a stated baseline and target before work begins.

 **Qualifications**

* 5\+ years of experience in technical program management, or a related program/product delivery role, ideally including some experience supporting enterprise, legal, compliance, or other regulated business functions.
* Strong working knowledge of SDLC methodologies and the software delivery lifecycle; able to structure and manage technical program delivery across cross\-functional engineering teams.
* Demonstrated ability to act as a translator between non\-technical business/legal stakeholders and engineering teams — turning ambiguous requirements into clear, actionable technical scope.
* Strong requirements\-gathering skills, including the ability to ask incisive clarifying questions, identify unstated assumptions, and drive stakeholders to a well\-scoped problem definition.
* High level of technical acumen: comfortable engaging in architecture and trade\-off conversations with engineers, without requiring a hands\-on coding background.
* A genuine focus on end user experience — able to advocate for usability and workflow simplicity even under legal/compliance complexity.
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build trust and strong working relationships across Legal, Compliance, Privacy, and Engineering.
* Superior program/project management and time\-management skills, including managing multiple priorities and cross\-functional dependencies in a fast\-paced, deadline\-driven environment.
* Proven ability to drive operating rhythm: building plans, tracking risks/dependencies, and communicating clearly with data to drive alignment and decisions.
* Familiarity with AI and automation tools (e.g., Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT, agentic AI/workflow platforms) and a demonstrated interest in applying them to accelerate program delivery.
* Proven history of taking initiative, working independently, and proactively identifying areas of need and generating recommended action plans.
* Intellectual curiosity with a demonstrated willingness to dive into new legal, compliance, and technical domains.
* Preferred Prior experience working with or adjacent to a Legal, Compliance, or Privacy organization.
* Experience with legal tech / workflow orchestration platforms (e.g., Tonkean, ServiceNow, Ironclad, Legal Tracker) or comparable enterprise workflow tools.

Skanska’s construction and project delivery expertise translates directly into maximum savings and quality.

jobs.description:
**Program Manager**

  

  

**Location:** Hybrid; California\-based, with a strong preference for the San Francisco Bay Area  

**Status:** Full\-time, Exempt  

**Reports to:** Program Director  

**Salary Range:** $76,800–$115,200  

  

**About the Center for Care Innovations**  

The Center for Care Innovations (CCI) is a nonprofit organization working to transform the health care safety net. Our mission is to spark, seed, and spread innovations that strengthen the health and wellbeing of historically underinvested communities.  

  

For more than 25 years, CCI has worked alongside safety net organizations to navigate a changing health care landscape, test new approaches, strengthen organizations and leaders, and help promising ideas spread across the field. Rooted in California, we partner with community health centers, public hospitals, community\-based organizations, managed care plans, public agencies, and philanthropy.  

  

Our work spans capacity\-building initiatives, advising and consulting, and ecosystem development: running intensive learning collaboratives and accelerators, providing tailored advising and research, and hosting cross\-sector gatherings. These bring people together to tackle some of the health care safety net's most pressing challenges.

  

  

For more information, please see the www.careinnovations.org (http://www.careinnovations.org/).
  

  

**About the Program Manager Role**  

CCI is looking for a collaborative, curious, and organized Program Manager to design and lead initiatives that help health care safety net organizations improve care and advance health equity. This is a great role for someone who enjoys moving between strategy and implementation, turning big ideas into actionable initiatives, building strong relationships, making sense of data and complex information, facilitating engaging learning experiences, and keeping complex work moving forward.  

  

We're looking for someone who understands the health care safety net ecosystem and brings deeper experience in at least one part of it. This is a highly relational and outward\-facing role, working with health care organizations, funders, partners, and other stakeholders in both virtual and in\-person settings.  

  

**What** **You'll Do**


* **Design initiatives that respond to real\-world challenges.** Work with CCI colleagues and partners to translate ideas into actionable initiatives through landscape research, stakeholder interviews, work planning, and the development of content and learning experiences. Depending on the initiative, you may draw on approaches such as human\-centered design, quality improvement, and other methods for supporting organizational and systems change.


* **Lead initiatives through implementation.** Manage the day\-to\-day work of multiple initiatives, including timelines, deliverables, budgets, team roles, consultants, and grant requirements. Anticipate challenges, solve problems, coordinate work across teams, and help teams adjust as the work evolves.


* **Build and steward strong relationships.** Develop trusted relationships with key stakeholders, bringing a responsive, collaborative, equity\-centered, and service\-oriented approach to the work.


* **Create engaging learning experiences.** Design and confidently facilitate virtual and in\-person convenings, workshops, meetings, and other learning experiences. Prepare speakers and partners, develop agendas and activities, present content, facilitate conversations, and create welcoming spaces where participants can learn from one another and put new ideas into practice.


* **Use data to learn, improve, and communicate impact.** Gather, analyze, and interpret quantitative and qualitative data to understand how initiatives are progressing, identify opportunities for improvement, and inform decision\-making. Translate findings and complex information into clear insights and recommendations for internal teams, participants, partners, and funders.


* **Manage grants, contracts, and funder relationships.** Manage initiative budgets, track spending, contribute to narrative and data\-driven funder reports, and communicate clearly with funders about progress, learning, challenges, and results. Support the identification and management of faculty, coaches, consultants, and other partners.


**You Might Be a Great Fit If You...**


* Have at least five years of experience managing complex initiatives, ideally in health care, public health, nonprofit, community\-based, or related settings.


* Have a master's degree in public health, public policy, health care administration, nonprofit management, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.


* Bring a strong understanding of the health care safety net ecosystem, with deeper knowledge or experience in at least one area, such as Federally Qualified Health Centers (FQHCs), Medi\-Cal Managed Care Plans, or other California safety net organizations.


* Have experience running or supporting learning collaboratives, accelerators, technical assistance initiatives, or other capacity\-building efforts.


* Are an excellent manager who can translate broad goals into clear work plans, timelines, roles, and deliverables and keep complex work moving forward.


* Are skilled at developing and maintaining trusted relationships with partners and stakeholders.


* Are a confident and engaging communicator who can present, facilitate, and translate complex information clearly for a range of audiences, including funders and external partners, both virtually and in person.


* Have strong quantitative and qualitative data analysis skills and can use data to inform decision\-making, learning, and communication.


* Are comfortable navigating ambiguity, solving problems, experimenting with new approaches, and adjusting course as you learn.


* Bring a commitment to advancing health equity and improving care for historically underinvested

We are building a governance, risk, and compliance function to enable our company to buildproducts that can withstand regulatory scrutiny, and ensure Meta continues to meet globalregulatory requirements and manage risk. Meta's Risk and Compliance Program (RCP) is the central engine driving risk management and compliance at the company, supporting Meta and the family of apps. Within RCP, the Security Risk Program (SRP) is the second\-line function accountable for how Meta identifies, assesses, quantifies, and reports its security risk posture — delivering global security risk assessments, Capability Maturity \& Effectiveness (CME) evaluations, AI and cloud risk assessments, and board\-level and regulatory reporting.We are seeking a Security Risk Program Manager to build one of the program's highest\-priority new capabilities: security risk assessment of AI product launches. Today, AI launches receivead\-hoc coverage through security risk assessments designed for infrastructure — not forproduct\-launch cadence, and not for cross\-domain AI risk spanning Security, Privacy, Integrity,and Legal. You will design that capability from the ground up and scale it from roughly fiveassessments per quarter today to twenty or more per quarter by H1 2027, in step with Meta's AIproduct velocity.This is a builder and an influencer role in equal measure. AI launch risk cannot beassessed by one function acting alone — it requires Central Security, product groups, Privacy,Integrity, and Legal moving through a shared process on a launch timeline. You will own thatoperating model: translating product and engineering reality into a defensible risk position, andtranslating regulatory obligation into assessment work that product teams can actually absorbwithout stalling a launch. jobs.description:
* Sunnyvale, CA, United States
* Not Remote

### **Company Description**


It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at **Intuitive**. As a global leader in **robotic\-assisted surgery** and **minimally invasive care**, our technologies—like the **da Vinci surgical system** and **Ion**—have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide.


We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world.


The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life.


If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help **transform the future of healthcare**, you’ll find your purpose here.


### **Job Description**


**Primary Function of Position:**


We are seeking a process\-oriented Pricing Operations Analyst to support how pricing reaches the customer: the global price books that carry it, the contracted pricing that governs it, and the Configure Price Quote (CPQ) system that executes it.


Pricing operations is where commercial strategy becomes real. This role designs the processes and system logic that make quoting accurate, fast, and simple for the sales teams and customers who depend on it, and serves as the practical expert on what can be delivered within existing system constraints: what is achievable, in what sequence, and at what operational cost.


Partnering with regional pricing, Sales Operations, Contracts, Customer Service, Product Management, and Systems teams, the Analyst will create excellence in the transaction experience, quoting process, and pricing fidelity across the quote\-to\-cash continuum. Success in this role is measured less by analysis produced than by how reliably price is executed worldwide.


**Roles \& Responsibilities:**


**Price Book Management**


* Support creation and maintenance of global price books, including new product introductions, list price changes, regional variants, effective dating, and ongoing accuracy.
* Drive the pricing release calendar, coordinating change windows with commercial, regional, and systems stakeholders.

**Contract\-Based Pricing**


* Activate and maintain contracted, deviated, and tiered customer pricing in CPQ and ERP, including GPO and IDN agreement terms, membership eligibility, and price expiration tracking.
* Research and resolve price discrepancies across quote, order, and invoice, correcting the underlying system condition rather than the individual transaction.
* Support the discount approval process for local commercial leader price decisions.

**Systems and Configuration**


* Configure and maintain CPQ pricing logic, discounting rules, and approval workflows.
* Perform regression testing of pricing logic following each system change or price book release.
* Partner with Systems and IT on CPQ build, enhancement scoping, and defect resolution.

**Process Design and Optimization**


* Design, document, and improve repeatable price execution processes, removing friction across the quote\-to\-cash continuum.
* Evaluate trade\-offs between process change and system change, and recommend the approach that delivers the outcome soonest at acceptable operational cost.

**Enablement and Customer Experience**


* Train and enable sales, sales operations, and regional pricing teams on quoting and price execution, acting as the first point of contact for how\-to questions.
* Improve the quoting and purchasing experience for sales teams and customers, treating both as the customer of this function.

**Controls and Reporting**


* Maintain controls and audit\-ready documentation for all price book and contract pricing changes.
* Report on price execution accuracy and quoting cycle time, and act on the trends that surface.

### **Qualifications**


**Required Skills and Experience:**


* Minimum of 3 years of relevant experience in pricing operations, sales operations, order management, contract administration, or business process roles, including a minimum of 2 years of hands\-on CPQ configuration.
* Hands\-on configuration experience with a CPQ platform, including pricing rules and approval workflows.
* Direct experience administering contracted or deviated customer pricing.
* Demonstrated process design and process mapping capability, with clear written documentation.
* Attention to detail and accuracy when working with high\-volume pricing data.
* Ability to identify workable solutions inside a fixed system, and to explain trade\-offs between process change and system change to non\-technical stakeholders.
* Service orientation toward internal partners and external customers.
* Advanced Excel skills, with working knowledge of Tableau.
* Strong collaborator across time zones and functions, with a focus on process integration and optimization.
* This role requires approximately 10% travel, including international travel.
* This role requires working onsite in our Sunnyvale, CA office Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday every week.

**Required Education and Training**


* Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Operations, or a related field

**Preferred Skills and Experience**


* Background in or familiarity with the healthcare industry, medical devices, and hospital operations.
* Familiarity with GPO and IDN contract structures and healthcare contract administration.
* Hands\-on experience with SAP or a comparable ERP system, and ownership of price books or comparable master data.
* Experience applying generative AI tools to process automation and documentation.

new_jobs.description:
**About The Role**

The Financial Operations Analyst will analyze tariffs, trade compliance and operational data to support financial reporting, improve accuracy, and enhance efficiency. This role ensures data integrity, compliance with standards, and optimizes reporting systems for data\-driven decision\-making. The analyst will drive process improvements to boost operational efficiency, financial accuracy, and reporting effectiveness, while providing valuable insights to departments including procurement, logistics, warehouse, production, engineering, customer operations, and finance.


**What You Will Do**

* Review, validate, and modify tariff tool raw data to ensure accuracy, completeness, and compliance with trade requirements.
* Analyze, validate, prepare, and submit Post Summary Corrections (PSC) and Customs Protests to ensure compliance with U.S. Customs regulations.
* Conduct reconciliations among ACE data (US customs website), Accounts Payable (AP) data, PSC filings, and tariff management tools to identify and resolve discrepancies.
* Investigate data variances and compliance exceptions, implementing corrective actions as necessary.
* Prepare reports, analyses, and supporting documentation for customs audits, compliance reviews, and management reporting.
* Collaborate with Customs Brokers, Logistics, Finance, Procurement, and Operations teams to ensure accurate trade compliance data and reporting.
* Support duty recovery, tariff mitigation, and customs compliance initiatives through data analysis and process improvements.
* Provide support for ad hoc trade compliance requests, regulatory inquiries, management reporting, and special projects.
* Maintain accurate records and documentation in accordance with company policies and regulatory requirements.

**What You Bring**

* Bachelor’s or above in Data Analytics, Finance, Accounting, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field required.
* 1\+ years of relevant experience in the finance or data analysis field preferred
* Advanced PC skills and proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel
* Independent problem solver with ability to decode large quantities of complex data into easy\-to\-understand findings, observations, and action items.
* Detail oriented and committed to deadlines.
* Excellent communication, written, and presentation skills.
* Familiar with financial and data analysis principles, including tariff analysis, AP (Account Payable) reconciliation, trade compliance tracking, and key financial metrics, to generate insights and optimize business outcomes.
* Ability to identify opportunities for performance and procedure improvement across the organization.
* Highly analytical with the ability to handle complex problems and build models.
* Extensive experience in financial analysis and data visualization.
* Proven analytical background.
* Hands\-on experience with SAP, Python, Jira, and Tableau Prep is preferred.

new_jobs.title: Principal Technical Program Manager — Partner GTM Systems & Technology
new_jobs.description:
**Overview**
------------


Role Overview
Intuit is undergoing a major transformation to modernize, unify, and scale our global partner ecosystem. The Global Partner Program (GPP) is our unified GTM framework designed to standardize enrollment, tiering, commercial benefits, and support experiences for all partner tracks—including Accountants, Value\-Added Resellers (VARs), Developers, and ISVs—under a single platform: the Intuit Partner Suite (IPS).  

As the Technical Program Manager for Partner GTM Systems \& Technology Roadmap, you will own the technical execution engine of this program. You will serve as the single operations interface into the data and systems engineering teams. Your mission is to translate high\-level program strategies into robust technical specifications, maintain and author all Business Requirements Documents (BRDs), manage the prioritization of the system roadmap, and aggressively mitigate technical risks to ensure flawless rollouts.

 **Responsibilities**

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* **Own the Technical Backlog \& Roadmap:** Drive the technical prioritization, sequencing, and delivery roadmap for the Intuit Partner Suite (PRM/Portal) and integrated GTM tools (Salesforce, DocuSign, Quickbase, and Varicent) in direct partnership with systems and engineering leaders.
* **Business Requirements (BRD) Authorship \& Lifecycle:** Author, update, and finalize comprehensive Business Requirements Documents (BRDs). You will translate complex partner strategies, multi\-tier revenue share structures, lead registration/protection rules, and tier\-aware support routing—into clear, implementation\-ready logic for developers.
* **Single Operations Interface to VEP/Engineering:** Act as the centralized point of contact for all technical requirements, unifying and streamlining communication channels to eliminate historical fragmentation between business, ops, and engineering.
* **Cross\-Functional Requirements Gathering:** Collaborate deeply with GPP Program Strategy to capture strategic intent, and PMO to map system dependencies, ensuring technical plans directly support GPP launch\-readiness schedules.
* **Technical Risk \& Blocker Mitigation:** Identify, track, and resolve system constraints and delivery risks. Focus areas include resolving data residency/GDPR requirements for international markets (UK, Canada, Australia) and managing the technical transition of legacy partner data into the new platform.
* **System Validation \& UAT Governance:** Define the operational quality standards and “Definition of Done” for technical deliverables. Lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and system validation to ensure shipped platform features exactly match defined business policies before they go live to partners.

 **Qualifications**

**Required Qualifications \& Experience**
-----------------------------------------

* **Systems Implementation Expertise:** 6\+ years of experience leading complex, large\-scale systems implementations across CRM (Salesforce/SFDC), Partner Relationship Management (PRM) platforms, Billing/Commerce engines, or Enterprise Data Warehouses.
* **Exceptional Business Analysis (BRD Writing):** A proven track record of writing exceptionally detailed, logic\-driven Business Requirements Documents (BRDs) that govern complex automation (e.g., tiered point accruals, referral payouts, and API\-driven data integrations).
* **Technical Translator:** Exceptional capability to bridge the gap between abstract business strategy and core engineering requirements, comfortably negotiating scope and trade\-offs with both Executive Directors and System Architects.
* **Cross\-Functional Collaborator:** Experience navigating highly matrixed enterprise organizations, with a demonstrated ability to align diverse stakeholder groups (Sales, Ops, Product, Success, Finance, and Legal).
* **Detail\-Oriented \& Risk\-Aware:** High analytical rigor with experience using structured risk\-management frameworks to identify operational constraints, system bugs, and process inefficiencies before they impact launch milestones.
* **Agile/Scrum Experience:** Strong familiarity with Agile delivery methodologies, backlog grooming, and Jira\-based sprint management.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience with PRM tools (e.g., Salesforce PRM, Impartner, ZiftONE).
* Familiarity with financial incentive systems (e.g., Varicent or automated revenue share platforms).
* Direct experience working within B2B SaaS partner programs, channel operations, or agency reseller ecosystems.

  

Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers \| Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.

Job ID: 2616541

**Location:** Bethesda, MD, US

**Date Posted:** 2026\-09\-04

**Category:** Program Management

**Subcategory:** Program Mgmt

**Schedule:** Full\-Time

**Shift:** Day Job

**Travel:** Yes \- 10% of the time

**Minimum Clearance Required:** TS.SCI\_wPoly

**Clearance Level Must Be Able to Obtain:** None

 **Description**


﻿SAIC, a leading provider of systems development \& deployment, targeting \& intelligence analysis, systems engineering \& integration, and training capabilities and solutions for the Intelligence Community, is seeking mission\-first professionals to fulfill their career goals and objectives while delivering day\-to\-day excellence on programs of national importance.



 SAIC seeks an experienced and results\-oriented, Senior Program Manager (PM) to manage our Prime contract focused on Technical Exploitation. This includes the daily management of a small team of seasoned professionals and well and the internal SAIC PM reporting and accountability requirements. The PM is the primary point of contact with the COR for matters involving technical performance, cost, and schedule and communication of progress and problems in a timely manner. The PM shall perform project managerial duties, which include but are not limited to maintaining required staffing levels of qualified personnel and assuring quality, content, and prompt delivery of all task and contractual deliverables. This position is primarily based at the customer site in Bethesda, MD.



 Responsibilities:


* Primary focal point for contract performance, to include technical performance, cost, schedule, security, staffing, and allocation of appropriate skill mix aligned with tasking and contract deliverables.
* Delivering on\-contract strategic and organic growth opportunities.
* Provide regular reports to SAIC leadership on customer requirements/changes.
* Implement and manage on\-boarding activities.
* Ensure the required level of expertise and competency of personnel are maintained in all assignments and kept current with rapidly evolving technologies.
* Ensure delivery of on\-time and quality work\-related products to the Customer and SAIC leadership.
* Ensure vacant positions are filled within the contract timelines by maintaining a pipeline of qualified candidates.
* Maintain awareness of SAIC solutions and surge support skills to present to customer at strategic opportunities.
* Coordinate and participate in quarterly Project Management Reviews (PMR)  

Track, manage, and control contract costs.

**Qualifications**


**Required Skills**

* Active TS/SCI with eligibility/ability to obtain and maintain a Counterintelligence Polygraph Clearance is required. Candidates without this cannot be considered.
* Bachelor’s Degree
* Minimum eight (8\) years of PM, project management, or technical leadership experience
* 18\+ years of overall professional experience
* Experience as a Program Manager managing teams of 10 or more technical professionals
* Experience in bringing innovative approaches to address complex problems bridging operational and technical domains
* Strong analytic ability to evaluate programmatic data, resolve inconsistencies and propose solutions to program issues
* Strong organizational skills
* Outstanding verbal and written communications skills
* Excellent interpersonal skills, including the ability and willingness to initiate and manage relationships across the customer leadership team

**Desired:**

* Bachelor’s Degree in STEM\-related field
* PMP
* 15 years of related work experience
* Experience as PM of technical exploitation teams
* Knowledge of military structure
* Prior experience managing an IDIQ contract


Target salary range: $200,001 \- $240,000\. The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position based on experience and other factors.

new_jobs.description:
Responsibilities:

Noblis is positioned to provide technology and operational solutions to senior decision makers in the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) in the Science and Technology (S\&T) Directorate. The DHS S\&T Directorate is the primary research and development arm of DHS and manages science and technology research, from development through transition, for the Department's operational components and first responders. Established by Congress to provide innovative solutions to the nation's homeland security challenges, S\&T is the core source of scientific and engineering expertise for DHS and is uniquely postured to enhance our nation's security and resilience by providing knowledge products and innovative technology solutions for the Homeland Security Enterprise (HSE).  

  

At Noblis and Noblis ESI, we have excellent teams of smart, collaborative, proactive experts and professionals. We are actively seeking to identify personnel to join our team of talented professionals who possess the experience, vision, commitment, and integrity to successfully support the S\&T mission.

  

The Senior Program Analyst – International will provide strategic, analytical, and program management support to the International Cooperative Program Office (ICPO) within the Department of Homeland Security’s (DHS) Science \& Technology Directorate (S\&T). ICPO enables DHS international engagements that discover innovation, leverage international capabilities, drive solutions, and influence science and technology security advancement world\-wide.  

The ICPO team develops partnerships with foreign governments and international organizations that enhance scientific and technical knowledge for homeland security purposes. International cooperative partnership can improve operational effectiveness, enhance affordability, and provide S\&T access to broader knowledge\-base and partner capabilities to provide impact across DHS mission areas.  

This position will support portfolio\-level engagements by providing project management, facilitation, and relationship management. The role requires engaging across S\&T, DHS, and USG partners to understand customer needs; analyzing technology requirements and partner capabilities; and developing engagement recommendations across regions. The successful candidate will navigate the nuanced relationships intrinsic to foreign partnerships.  

The successful candidate will be self\-motivated, operate well in a matrixed environment, effectively manage competing priorities, and be able to distill and communicate complex concepts to enable nontechnical managers to make informed decisions. **This is currently a hybrid position with a blend of on\-site and remote work, requiring staff to be on\-site at the DHS S\&T client site in Washington D.C. as needed. Applicants must be able to regularly commute to Washington D.C.**  

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:* Aggregating and synthesizing knowledge and data to inform decisions, analyses, and recommendations across mission areas.
* Providing strategic perspective on high\-priority U.S. and foreign cooperative RDT\&E efforts across the Homeland Security Enterprise.
* Developing status reports, briefings, and read\-ahead materials; organizing and coordinating meetings, discussions, and seminars. The employee is expected to be able to concisely communicate their findings to technical and non\-technical audiences as needed.
* Developing and maintaining S\&T international planning documents, to include international arrangements, implementation tracking, and closeout documentation.
* Managing multiple concurrent customer engagements and priorities, including responding to quick\-turn requests.
* Facilitating meetings and preparing clients for leadership and partner briefings.
* Facilitating partnerships between U.S. and international entities in homeland security research.
* Developing and maintaining standard operating procedures for ICPO’s working\-level and senior\-level events to enhance team efficiency.

  



The position may require international travel, up to 25%. Requires participation in meetings outside of regular 9am\-5pm ET work hours to accommodate coordination with partners in various time zones. Hybrid position, though subject to change based on Noblis and/or government requirements. Must be available to be on client site (Washington, DC) routinely.

* Bachelor’s degree with 10\+ years of related experience OR Advanced Degree with 5\+ years of related experience. Preference for Degrees in International Relations, Government, Public Policy, or a similar field.
* Eligibility to obtain a Secret Clearance and DHS Suitability determination.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate complex technical information to a variety of audiences.
* Excellent interpersonal and relationship\-building skills with the ability to work effectively with a diverse range of stakeholders, both domestic and international.


Desired Qualifications:

* Experience supporting USG\-led international cooperative programs involving foreign government engagement, including program management, partner coordination, or strategic planning across research, development, or operational mission areas.
* Experience with strategy and development for RDT\&E cooperation with Western Hemisphere foreign government partners or multilateral fora.
* Understanding of current global security threats and homeland security priorities.

* Experience providing direct or consultant support to major programs or system development efforts, preferably supporting national security internationally.
* Demonstrated ability to independently develop and execute project plans with minimal oversight.

new_jobs.title: Principal Technical Program Manager — Partner GTM Systems & Technology
new_jobs.description:
**Overview**
------------


Role Overview
Intuit is undergoing a major transformation to modernize, unify, and scale our global partner ecosystem. The Global Partner Program (GPP) is our unified GTM framework designed to standardize enrollment, tiering, commercial benefits, and support experiences for all partner tracks—including Accountants, Value\-Added Resellers (VARs), Developers, and ISVs—under a single platform: the Intuit Partner Suite (IPS).  

As the Technical Program Manager for Partner GTM Systems \& Technology Roadmap, you will own the technical execution engine of this program. You will serve as the single operations interface into the data and systems engineering teams. Your mission is to translate high\-level program strategies into robust technical specifications, maintain and author all Business Requirements Documents (BRDs), manage the prioritization of the system roadmap, and aggressively mitigate technical risks to ensure flawless rollouts.

 **Responsibilities**

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* **Own the Technical Backlog \& Roadmap:** Drive the technical prioritization, sequencing, and delivery roadmap for the Intuit Partner Suite (PRM/Portal) and integrated GTM tools (Salesforce, DocuSign, Quickbase, and Varicent) in direct partnership with systems and engineering leaders.
* **Business Requirements (BRD) Authorship \& Lifecycle:** Author, update, and finalize comprehensive Business Requirements Documents (BRDs). You will translate complex partner strategies, multi\-tier revenue share structures, lead registration/protection rules, and tier\-aware support routing—into clear, implementation\-ready logic for developers.
* **Single Operations Interface to VEP/Engineering:** Act as the centralized point of contact for all technical requirements, unifying and streamlining communication channels to eliminate historical fragmentation between business, ops, and engineering.
* **Cross\-Functional Requirements Gathering:** Collaborate deeply with GPP Program Strategy to capture strategic intent, and PMO to map system dependencies, ensuring technical plans directly support GPP launch\-readiness schedules.
* **Technical Risk \& Blocker Mitigation:** Identify, track, and resolve system constraints and delivery risks. Focus areas include resolving data residency/GDPR requirements for international markets (UK, Canada, Australia) and managing the technical transition of legacy partner data into the new platform.
* **System Validation \& UAT Governance:** Define the operational quality standards and “Definition of Done” for technical deliverables. Lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and system validation to ensure shipped platform features exactly match defined business policies before they go live to partners.

 **Qualifications**

**Required Qualifications \& Experience**
-----------------------------------------

* **Systems Implementation Expertise:** 6\+ years of experience leading complex, large\-scale systems implementations across CRM (Salesforce/SFDC), Partner Relationship Management (PRM) platforms, Billing/Commerce engines, or Enterprise Data Warehouses.
* **Exceptional Business Analysis (BRD Writing):** A proven track record of writing exceptionally detailed, logic\-driven Business Requirements Documents (BRDs) that govern complex automation (e.g., tiered point accruals, referral payouts, and API\-driven data integrations).
* **Technical Translator:** Exceptional capability to bridge the gap between abstract business strategy and core engineering requirements, comfortably negotiating scope and trade\-offs with both Executive Directors and System Architects.
* **Cross\-Functional Collaborator:** Experience navigating highly matrixed enterprise organizations, with a demonstrated ability to align diverse stakeholder groups (Sales, Ops, Product, Success, Finance, and Legal).
* **Detail\-Oriented \& Risk\-Aware:** High analytical rigor with experience using structured risk\-management frameworks to identify operational constraints, system bugs, and process inefficiencies before they impact launch milestones.
* **Agile/Scrum Experience:** Strong familiarity with Agile delivery methodologies, backlog grooming, and Jira\-based sprint management.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience with PRM tools (e.g., Salesforce PRM, Impartner, ZiftONE).
* Familiarity with financial incentive systems (e.g., Varicent or automated revenue share platforms).
* Direct experience working within B2B SaaS partner programs, channel operations, or agency reseller ecosystems.

  

Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers \| Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.

new_jobs.description:
Business Analyst


Business Technology Integrators (BTI) is a Service\-Disabled Veteran\-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) with more than 25 years of experience delivering innovative and reliable IT and engineering solutions to the Federal Government. BTI supports mission\-critical programs across defense and civilian agencies, with core expertise in cybersecurity, program management, enterprise IT, and technical oversight services.  

BTI is currently searching for a Business Analyst to fulfill the roles and responsibilities below: **Roles** **and** **Responsibilities**
The Business Analyst is responsible for eliciting, analyzing, documenting, and validating functional and non\-functional requirements for the EFAST2 system across the full lifecycle of the modernization effort from initial Transition\-In discovery through Core Development, Integration, Go\-Live, Hypercare, and into steady\-state Operations \& Maintenance.  

This role leads discovery activities during Transition\-In, including structured knowledge\-transfer sessions with the incumbent O\&M vendor, to capture existing system functionality, clarify ambiguous or undocumented requirements, and identify gaps between current capabilities and Government objectives, and works closely with the Project Manager, Technical Lead, UI/UX Specialist, and Product Owner to build and continuously refine the product backlog so that user stories are prioritized by business value and technical dependency and contain complete, testable acceptance criteria.  

The Business Analyst reviews wireframes and UX mockups developed by the UI/UX Specialist against documented requirements to confirm alignment prior to Product Owner approval, and remains actively engaged throughout each sprint to validate that delivered functionality satisfies the documented business requirements and acceptance criteria prior to story completion, reviewing developed features against the original requirement intent, participating in sprint reviews and UAT sessions to confirm correct implementation of business rules and DER/edit\-test logic, and identifying and reporting discrepancies between delivered functionality and specified requirements.  

The Business Analyst maintains end\-to\-end requirements traceability (Roadmap User Stories Tasks Test Results) across all annual rollover cycles, ensuring that as the system evolves — through new epics, annual forms changes, and post\-go\-live enhancements — validated requirements remain accurate and any implementation drift is caught and corrected, and serves as the ongoing liaison between EBSA/OCIO business stakeholders and the technical development team for the life of the contract.  

Experience/Qualifications* Undergraduate college degree from an accredited college or university in business administration, information systems, computer science, or related discipline, or equivalent experience

* At least 6 years of experience performing business analysis, requirements gathering, and documentation for IT application development projects

* At least 3 years of experience working within an Agile/Scrum environment, writing and refining user stories, epics, and acceptance criteria

* Experience validating delivered functionality against documented business requirements and acceptance criteria, including UAT support and sprint review participation, prior to Government sign\-off

* Experience conducting stakeholder meetings, facilitating requirements workshops, and leading knowledge\-transfer or discovery sessions with incumbent contractors or legacy system owners

* Experience translating business and regulatory requirements (e.g., ERISA, Form 5500 series filing requirements) into functional specifications and system design inputs

* Experience with Jira for requirements traceability and backlog management, and with Confluence and Microsoft SharePoint for organizing project documentation and requirements artifacts

* Experience reviewing wireframes and UX mockups against documented requirements to confirm alignment prior to Product Owner approval

* Working knowledge of federal IT development processes, including Section 508 accessibility requirements and information security considerations.

* Experience supporting annual system change cycles, including analyzing legislative or regulatory changes for system impact and validating that rollover implementations match specified requirements

new_jobs.description:
**Benefits:**
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Training \& development
* Vision insurance
**Position Overview**
Mission One is seeking a Mid\-Level Cyber Intelligence Analyst,who is familiar with the space domain,to conduct all\-source intelligence analysis of foreign cyber capabilities, operations, and threats. The analyst will assess adversary cyber doctrine, strategy, tactics, techniques and procedures (TTPs), infrastructure, vulnerabilities, emerging technologies, and offensive and defensive capabilities. The role supports cyber operations, network defense, threat assessments, mission assurance, and operational decision\-making while performing cross\-functional duties across Intelligence Requirements Coordination (IRC), Intelligence Mission Integration, and Intelligence Analysis.  

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Cyber \& Intelligence Analysis:
	+ Analyze cyber programs and activities intended to compromise, disrupt, degrade, or neutralize U.S. and allied information systems and networks.
	+ Develop cyber threat, threat capability, and vulnerability assessments affecting space, ground, and information environments.
	+ Assess adversary capabilities, vulnerabilities, intent, and potential mission impacts using intelligence from across the Intelligence Community (IC).
	+ Produce and disseminate decision\-quality intelligence products and senior\-level analytic assessments.
	+ Conduct red\-team, alternative\-futures, and other structured analytic activities to identify risk, challenge assumptions, and support mission planning.
	+ Maintain intelligence tools, dashboards, production schedules, and analytic workflows, incorporating IC feedback to improve product relevance and operational value.
* Intelligence Requirements Coordination (IRC):
	+ Develop and refine Priority Intelligence Requirements (PIRs) and manage Requests for Information (RFIs).
	+ Coordinate, track, deconflict, and advocate intelligence requirements across IC partners and stakeholders.
	+ Identify collection and analytic gaps, facilitate intelligence access, and support requirements coordination.
	+ Support crisis planning, CONOP development, intelligence annexes, wargaming, and intelligence dashboard management.
* Intelligence Mission Integration:
	+ Develop and maintain space\-based threat estimates using Joint Intelligence Preparation of the Operational Environment (JIPOE).
	+ Produce time\-sensitive intelligence and data\-driven threat analytics in support of mission and operational requirements.
	+ Coordinate collection strategies and maintain situational awareness through intelligence tools and dashboards.
	+ Connect organizations with appropriate IC partners, subject\-matter experts, and analytic resources.
	+ Provide intelligence support to acquisition, exercises, crisis response, continuity operations, counterspace missions, anomaly resolution, and emergency response.

**Required Qualifications**
* Minimum of eight (8\) years of relevant professional experience supporting cyber\-related missions, intelligence analysis, space operations, or activities.
* Bachelor’s degree in a related field.
* Demonstrated experience developing decision\-quality materials, including strategic papers, options analyses, executive briefings, and executive action\-tracking products.
* Demonstrated knowledge in Intelligence Requirements Coordination, Intelligence Mission Integration, and Intelligence Analysis.
* Active security clearance required; clearance level will be determined by contract requirements.

**Desired Qualifications**
* Comprehensive mission knowledge supported by relevant developmental training and professional experience.
* Ability to derive and clearly communicate analytic judgments from incomplete, indirect, highly complex, seemingly unrelated, or technically advanced information.
* Ability to structure analytic work using trends in reporting and perspectives from multiple analysts, organizations, and intelligence disciplines.
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate across the IC on information sharing, collection requirements, analytic coordination, and resolution of competing perspectives.
* Ability to develop concise, insightful, and comprehensive defense intelligence products for operational and senior\-level audiences.
* Demonstrated ability to lead or contribute to teams researching multifaceted, complex, or mission\-critical problems.

The Office of Transformation is responsible for leading the design and execution of enterprise\-wide transformation initiatives across NPR to support our ambitious goals for audience growth and enhanced Network collaboration. The Project Manager functions as the central operational coordinator within the Office of Transformation. Tasked with steering high\-priority initiatives, this role oversees complex transition timelines, coordinates deliverables between multiple independent teams, and ensures all project milestones are hit on schedule. This position requires a collaborative, detail\-driven leader who can seamlessly bridge operational gaps between technical, financial, and station relations functions.

* Timeline \& Milestone Enforcement: Design, monitor, and manage the master project roadmaps for critical Transformation initiatives, driving accountability across cross\-functional streams.

* Status Reporting \& Governance: Maintain real\-time status dashboards and reports, facilitate meetings, and package project updates for institutional leadership.
* Coordination Support: Assist the SVP of Transformation in coordinating projects and resources across NPR teams to further our Transformation goals.


**The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description can be modified at any time.**


### **Minimum Qualifications**


* 3\-5 years of dedicated professional project management experience steering enterprise\-level transitions or systems implementations.
* Demonstrated experience using advanced project management tracking methodologies, software, and dashboarding tools.
* Proven success directing cross\-departmental teams where deliverables depend on multiple matrixed stakeholders.

* Prior project management experience within a media organization, membership association, or non\-profit system.
* Familiarity tracking project timelines that intersect with CRM (Salesforce) database integrations or corporate compliance updates.

new_jobs.description:
**About Radiant**
-----------------


Radiant is an El Segundo, CA\-based startup building the world’s first mass\-produced, portable nuclear microreactors. The company’s first reactor, Kaleidos, is a 1\-megawatt, fail\-safe microreactor that can be transported anywhere power is needed and run for up to 5 years without refueling. Portable nuclear power with rapid\-deploy capability can replace similar\-sized diesel generators and provide critical asset support for hospitals, data centers, remote sites, and military bases. Radiant’s unique, practical approach to nuclear development leverages modern software engineering to rapidly deliver safe, factory\-built microreactors that use existing, well\-qualified materials. Founded in 2020, Radiant is on track to test its first reactor at the Idaho National Laboratory this summer, with initial customer deliveries beginning in 2028\.

  

About the Role


Radiant is seeking a talented Technical Program Manager, IT \& Security, to own visibility and delivery across our IT and security program portfolio. You will track eight concurrent programs spanning three states: a reactor program at Idaho National Laboratory; a fuel facility and manufacturing plant in Tennessee; warehouse and office buildouts in Los Angeles; a site decommissioning; and a CMMC and NIST SP 800\-171 compliance program running across all of it.


We have strong technical leaders on each effort. What we don't have is one person who can see the whole portfolio at once, keep it visible, and ensure teams meet commitments. In this role, you won't write the SSP or design the network. You'll make sure the people doing that work are aligned, unblocked, and delivering against a schedule everyone can see. You'll represent IT leadership in meetings we can't attend, and you'll be the reason nothing quietly slips.


Responsibilities \& Duties

* Build the system of record for how IT and security programs are tracked at Radiant, standing up the tooling, cadence, and reporting that today lives across spreadsheets, inboxes, and people's heads.
* Own the operating cadence, including recurring status meetings within IT and security and cross\-functional reviews with facilities, construction, engineering, and external partners; set agendas, drive to decisions, capture actions, and follow up.
* Maintain integrated schedules, dependencies, risks, and milestones across concurrent programs; know what's on track, what's at risk, and what needs escalation before anyone asks.
* Keep IT scope sequenced with construction, partnering with the facilities project manager to ensure structured cabling, MDF/IDF, low\-voltage, access control, cameras, wireless, and carrier circuits are planned into general contractor milestones rather than retrofitted after drywall.
* Support the CMMC and NIST SP 800\-171 compliance program alongside executives, tracking milestone plans, POA\&M status, remediation coordination, evidence collection, and assessor coordination while technical control decisions remain with the security team.
* Produce technical and network diagrams, architecture documentation, project charters, status reporting, and executive summaries.
* Escalate slipping commitments and unresolved blockers to the VP of IT and VP of Cybersecurity early enough to act on them.


Required Qualifications \& Skills

* 6\+ years in technical program or project management, including infrastructure and security programs.
* Experience delivering IT infrastructure into new construction or facility buildouts, manufacturing, industrial, healthcare, or multi\-site commercial.
* Ability to read a construction schedule, work with a facilities PM and general contractor, and know when the window for IT work opens and closes.
* Hands\-on experience administering and structuring work in Atlassian tooling, building Jira projects, workflows, dashboards, and Confluence spaces that teams actually adopted.
* Ability to hold your own in an architecture review: read and produce network diagrams, understand infrastructure and security concepts, and ask the right questions of engineers without needing translation.
* Experience in a regulated environment, nuclear, defense, aerospace, life sciences, or similar, including work under compliance frameworks.
* Track record of driving accountability without direct authority, through influence, clear artifacts, and disciplined follow\-through.
* Strong written communication, documentation that engineers respect and executives can act on.


Desired Qualifications \& Skills

* Familiarity with CMMC, NIST SP 800\-171, or FedRAMP.
* Experience in DOE, a national laboratory, or ITAR\-controlled environments.
* Exposure to OT and IT convergence in manufacturing or plant settings.
* Site decommissioning or IT asset disposition experience.
* PMP or equivalent formal project management training.


Additional Requirements

* Must be willing to work extended hours and weekends as necessary to accomplish our mission.
* Must work 100% onsite at Radiant's El Segundo HQ.
* Travel up to 15%, heavier during site activation windows.

Intuit is undergoing a major transformation to modernize, unify, and scale our global partner ecosystem. The SWE Central Operations team provides strategic and operational support to the global Software Engineering organization, including fiscal planning, headcount management, budgeting, organizational strategy, executive reporting, and operational excellence. In this role, you will lead programs that improve resource planning, reporting, and business operations by partnering with engineering leaders and cross\-functional teams to develop scalable processes, analytics, and technology solutions. You will leverage data and agentic AI tools to streamline planning, automate analytical workflows, improve reporting quality, and generate actionable insights that support executive decision\-making. Success in this role requires balancing strategic thinking with operational execution, identifying opportunities to improve efficiency, and driving initiatives that enable the organization to scale effectively.  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**  

  

Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience required.  

  

**Minimum Qualifications**  

  

Proven experience leading complex cross\-functional programs within large organizations.  

  

Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and critical thinking skills with exceptional attention to detail and commitment to data integrity.  

  

Proficient in leveraging agentic AI tools for strategic planning and analytical workflows  

  

Experience with resource planning, headcount management, budgeting, forecasting, and operational reporting.  

  

Ability to influence stakeholders and build strong partnerships across Engineering, Finance, Recruiting, People Business Partners, Business Operations, and Tooling teams.  

  

Strong communication and executive presentation skills, with the ability to translate complex information into clear business insights.  

  

Experience partnering with engineering tools teams to define business requirements and deliver reporting or analytics solutions.  

  

Proficiency in Excel and Keynote; experience with Workday, Tableau, or similar analytics platforms is a plus.  

  

**Pay \& Benefits**  

  

At Apple, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base pay range for this role is between $120,900 and $249,000, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.  

  

Apple employees also have the opportunity to become an Apple shareholder through participation in Apple's discretionary employee stock programs. Apple employees are eligible for discretionary restricted stock unit awards, and can purchase Apple stock at a discount if voluntarily participating in Apple's Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You'll also receive benefits including: Comprehensive medical and dental coverage, retirement benefits, a range of discounted products and free services, and for formal education related to advancing your career at Apple, reimbursement for certain educational expenses \- including tuition. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary bonuses or commission payments as well as relocation. Learn more about Apple Benefits  

  

Note: Apple benefit, compensation and employee stock programs are subject to eligibility requirements and other terms of the applicable plan or program.

**Program Manager**

  

  

**Location:** Hybrid; California\-based, with a strong preference for the San Francisco Bay Area  

**Status:** Full\-time, Exempt  

**Reports to:** Program Director  

**Salary Range:** $76,800–$115,200  

  

**About the Center for Care Innovations**  

The Center for Care Innovations (CCI) is a nonprofit organization working to transform the health care safety net. Our mission is to spark, seed, and spread innovations that strengthen the health and wellbeing of historically underinvested communities.  

  

For more than 25 years, CCI has worked alongside safety net organizations to navigate a changing health care landscape, test new approaches, strengthen organizations and leaders, and help promising ideas spread across the field. Rooted in California, we partner with community health centers, public hospitals, community\-based organizations, managed care plans, public agencies, and philanthropy.  

  

Our work spans capacity\-building initiatives, advising and consulting, and ecosystem development: running intensive learning collaboratives and accelerators, providing tailored advising and research, and hosting cross\-sector gatherings. These bring people together to tackle some of the health care safety net's most pressing challenges.

  

  

For more information, please see the www.careinnovations.org (http://www.careinnovations.org/).
  

  

**About the Program Manager Role**  

CCI is looking for a collaborative, curious, and organized Program Manager to design and lead initiatives that help health care safety net organizations improve care and advance health equity. This is a great role for someone who enjoys moving between strategy and implementation, turning big ideas into actionable initiatives, building strong relationships, making sense of data and complex information, facilitating engaging learning experiences, and keeping complex work moving forward.  

  

We're looking for someone who understands the health care safety net ecosystem and brings deeper experience in at least one part of it. This is a highly relational and outward\-facing role, working with health care organizations, funders, partners, and other stakeholders in both virtual and in\-person settings.  

  

**What** **You'll Do**


* **Design initiatives that respond to real\-world challenges.** Work with CCI colleagues and partners to translate ideas into actionable initiatives through landscape research, stakeholder interviews, work planning, and the development of content and learning experiences. Depending on the initiative, you may draw on approaches such as human\-centered design, quality improvement, and other methods for supporting organizational and systems change.


* **Lead initiatives through implementation.** Manage the day\-to\-day work of multiple initiatives, including timelines, deliverables, budgets, team roles, consultants, and grant requirements. Anticipate challenges, solve problems, coordinate work across teams, and help teams adjust as the work evolves.


* **Build and steward strong relationships.** Develop trusted relationships with key stakeholders, bringing a responsive, collaborative, equity\-centered, and service\-oriented approach to the work.


* **Create engaging learning experiences.** Design and confidently facilitate virtual and in\-person convenings, workshops, meetings, and other learning experiences. Prepare speakers and partners, develop agendas and activities, present content, facilitate conversations, and create welcoming spaces where participants can learn from one another and put new ideas into practice.


* **Use data to learn, improve, and communicate impact.** Gather, analyze, and interpret quantitative and qualitative data to understand how initiatives are progressing, identify opportunities for improvement, and inform decision\-making. Translate findings and complex information into clear insights and recommendations for internal teams, participants, partners, and funders.


* **Manage grants, contracts, and funder relationships.** Manage initiative budgets, track spending, contribute to narrative and data\-driven funder reports, and communicate clearly with funders about progress, learning, challenges, and results. Support the identification and management of faculty, coaches, consultants, and other partners.


**You Might Be a Great Fit If You...**


* Have at least five years of experience managing complex initiatives, ideally in health care, public health, nonprofit, community\-based, or related settings.


* Have a master's degree in public health, public policy, health care administration, nonprofit management, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.


* Bring a strong understanding of the health care safety net ecosystem, with deeper knowledge or experience in at least one area, such as Federally Qualified Health Centers (FQHCs), Medi\-Cal Managed Care Plans, or other California safety net organizations.


* Have experience running or supporting learning collaboratives, accelerators, technical assistance initiatives, or other capacity\-building efforts.


* Are an excellent manager who can translate broad goals into clear work plans, timelines, roles, and deliverables and keep complex work moving forward.


* Are skilled at developing and maintaining trusted relationships with partners and stakeholders.


* Are a confident and engaging communicator who can present, facilitate, and translate complex information clearly for a range of audiences, including funders and external partners, both virtually and in person.


* Have strong quantitative and qualitative data analysis skills and can use data to inform decision\-making, learning, and communication.


* Are comfortable navigating ambiguity, solving problems, experimenting with new approaches, and adjusting course as you learn.


* Bring a commitment to advancing health equity and improving care for historically underinvested
